Slow Cooker Coconut Red Curry Chicken & Potatoes

Make this easy slow cooker chicken curry with tender chicken, potatoes, veggies and creamy coconut red curry sauce for a flavorful dinner.

Serves 4

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1½ lbs chicken breast or boneless (skinless chicken thighs)
  • 1 lb red baby potatoes (halved or quartered if large)
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp salt
  • ½ tsp black pepper
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 5 oz mild red curry paste
  • 1 can full-fat coconut milk
  • ½ cup chicken bone broth
  • 1 bag stir-fry vegetables (Asian-style frozen )
  • red pepper flakes (for heat)
  • additional seasonings to taste

Steps

  1. Add the Potatoes- Place the red baby potatoes in the bottom of your slow cooker, spreading them into an even layer.
  2. Add the Chicken- Place the chicken breasts or boneless, skinless chicken thighs directly on top of the potatoes.
  3. Season the Chicken- Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken. Add the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Mix everything together until the chicken is evenly coated while keeping the potatoes at the bottom of the slow cooker.
  4. Add the Curry Ingredients- Pour in the full-fat coconut milk, mild red curry paste, and chicken bone broth. Give everything a gentle stir until the curry paste is incorporated into the liquid. Try to keep the potatoes toward the bottom of the slow cooker.
  5. Slow Cook- Cover and cook on: LOW: 4–6 hours or HIGH: 3–4 hours. Cook until the chicken is fully cooked and the potatoes are fork-tender.
  6. Add the Vegetables- About 30 minutes before serving, add the frozen stir-fry vegetables. Give everything a good stir and try to get the vegetables as submerged in the curry sauce as possible.
  7. Finish Cooking- Cover and cook for another 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are heated through and tender.
  8. Adjust the Flavor- Taste the curry and adjust the seasonings as desired. Add additional salt, black pepper, garlic powder, curry paste, or other seasonings to taste. For extra heat, sprinkle in some red pepper flakes or chili flakes.
  9. Serve- Spoon the tender chicken, potatoes, vegetables, and creamy coconut red curry sauce into bowls. Serve with jasmine rice, brown rice, cauliflower rice, or naan bread and garnish with fresh cilantro if desired. Serve and Enjoy!

Source: Easy Eats Dietitian

High Protein Green Chili Chicken Cornbread Meal Prep

This Green Chili Chicken Cornbread Meal Prep combines creamy, cheesy green chili chicken with a sweet and savory cornbread topping for a comforting meal that feels anything but boring. Made with rotisserie chicken, Greek yogurt, corn, green chilis, and a honey cornbread topping, these individual meal prep bowls are easy to make and packed with protein.

Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 40 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 16 oz cooked chicken, shredded
  • 4 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce (can use chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, blended)
  • 4 tbsp taco seasoning (I use Siete)
  • 1 1/3 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
  • 4 tbsp light cream cheese
  • 1 cup corn
  • 1 tsp fresh lime juice
  • 4 tbsp salsa verde
  • 2 tbsp diced green chilis
  • 1/2 cup low-fat cheddar cheese, shredded
  • 1 cup honey cornbread mix (I use Jiffy)
  • 1/4 cup low-fat cottage cheese, blended (I use Good Culture)
  • 1 large egg
  • 1-2 fresh jalapeños (optional)
  • 1 tsp butter, melted (optional, for serving)
  • 1 tbsp honey (optional, for serving)

Steps

  1. Preheat your oven to 375°F.
  2. Soften the cream cheese. Grease four oven-safe meal prep containers that hold at least 26 ounces each.
  3. Divide the softened cream cheese, Greek yogurt, green salsa, chipotle pepper sauce, taco seasoning, and lime juice between the containers. Mix until smooth and well combined.
  4. Add the shredded chicken and corn to each container and mix until evenly coated in the creamy sauce.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine the honey cornbread mix, green chilis, shredded cheddar cheese, egg, and blended cottage cheese. Mix until just combined.
  6. Divide the cornbread mixture evenly between the four containers, spreading it over the chicken mixture. You should have approximately 1/3 cup of cornbread batter per container.
  7. If desired, top each with sliced fresh jalapeños.
  8. Place the containers on a baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 40–50 minutes, or until the cornbread topping is cooked through and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
  9. If desired, melt the butter and mix it with the honey. Drizzle or brush a little over each serving before eating.
  10. Let the meal prep bowls cool before covering and refrigerating.

Source: Simple Recipes by Sam

Crockpot Meatball Subs

if you haven’t made meatball subs yet this season, this is your sign 🫵🏼

Family ratings

Mom
Dad

Ingredients

  • 1.5 lb lean ground beef
  • 1 small yellow onion, diced
  • 3–4 garlic cloves, minced
  • ½ cup Italian breadcrumbs
  • ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
  • 1 egg
  • Oregano, salt & pepper to taste
  • 2x (24 oz) Jars Marinara Sauce (I like the Rao’s roasted garlic)
  • Sub Rolls
  • Cheese Slices for Topping (Provolone, Mozzarella, or Parmesan)

Steps

  1. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, oregano, salt, and pepper.
  2. Roll into 1–1½ inch meatballs
  3. Add 1 jar of marinara to the bottom of the crockpot
  4. Place meatballs in a single layer if possible
  5. Pour the second jar of sauce over the top, ensuring all meatballs are covered
  6. Cook on high for 3–4 hours or low for 5–6 hours, stirring once or twice
  7. Assemble subs and top with cheese of choice! I like to throw the subs in the oven on broil for a few minutes to let the cheese melt & toast the rolls!

1-Pot Creamy Sausage Couscous

Serves 6Prep 10 minCook 20 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 4 links Chicken Sausage
  • 2 tbsp Olive Oil
  • ½ White Onion, diced
  • 4 cloves Garlic, minced
  • ¼ cup Sun-Dried Tomatoes, chopped
  • 1 cup Couscous
  • 2½ cups Chicken Broth (Add more as needed)
  • 1 tsp Salt
  • 1 tsp Pepper
  • 1 tsp Red Pepper Flakes
  • 1 cup Spinach
  • ¼ cup Greek Yogurt
  • ⅛ cup Parmesan

Steps

  1. Slice your chicken sausage into ¼" pieces. In a pan on medium heat, brown the sausage on both sides. Remove the sausage from the pan and set aside.
  2. Add in your onion and garlic to the same pan and cook until fragrant (1-2 minutes).
  3. Dice your sun-dried tomatoes and add them to the same pan. Let this cook for an additional minute.
  4. Add in the couscous and let this crisp up for another minute.
  5. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil. Once the boil starts to happen, bring the pan down to a simmer and cover until fully cooked (should take 10-15 minutes). You can add more or less broth depending on how you like your couscous.
  6. Once this is nearly done cooking, add in the spinach, parmesan, and seasonings. Stir until fully combined and the spinach wilted down.
  7. Once this has finished cooking, add in your greek yogurt and stir to combine again. You can add more or less depending on how creamy you'd like your dish.
  8. Add back in the sausage, top with more parmesan, and enjoy!

Source: Kelsey's Food Reviews

Mix in the maple/honey and cook another 1-2 minutes until the beef is caramelized. Remove from the heat. Toss with sesame seeds. 3. Meanwhile, In a bowl, mix the cucumbers with 1 teaspoon salt, the chile flakes, ginger juice, and green onions. Let sit 5 minutes.4. Serve the beef and peppers over bowls of rice. 30 Minute Bang Bang Chicken

This 30-minute Bang Bang Chicken is a quick, high-protein dinner made with tender seasoned chicken thighs tossed in a creamy, spicy-sweet sriracha bang bang sauce. Served over rice with crunchy cabbage slaw and green onions, it’s an easy weeknight bowl packed with bold flavor and heat.

Serves 6Prep 20 minCook 10 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs chicken thighs, (cubed)
  • 2 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tbsp avocado oil
  • 1/3 cup mayo
  • 3 tbsp sriracha
  • 1/4 cup Thai sweet chili sauce
  • 1 tsp rice vinegar
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • Served with cauliflower rice or regular rice
  • Cabbage slaw
  • Freshly sliced green onions

Steps

  1. Cut the chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes and place them in a large bowl. Add the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Toss until the chicken is evenly coated.
  2. Preheat a pan over medium-high heat and drizzle in a little avocado oil. Once hot, add the chicken and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and golden on the edges.
  3. While the chicken cooks, make the bang bang sauce. In a small bowl, mix together the mayo, sriracha, Thai sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Taste and adjust by adding more chili sauce if you like extra heat or sweetness.
  4. Once the chicken is cooked through, pour in all but a few tablespoons of the sauce and stir to coat. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken and get slightly crispy around the edges.
  5. To assemble, start with a base of cauliflower rice or regular rice. Add a handful of cabbage slaw, then spoon the bang bang chicken on top. Drizzle with the reserved sauce and garnish with sliced green onions. Enjoy!

Source: Cailee Eats

5 Minute Dinner Prep: Salsa Verde Chicken Bake

🌶️🍗🌽5 Minute Dinner Prep: Salsa Verde Chicken Bake

Serves 4

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup uncooked long grain white rice
  • 2 cups chicken broth
  • 1 can black beans, drained rinsed
  • 1 cup corn (frozen or canned, drained)
  • 1 jar salsa verde
  • 4 chicken breasts (I cut mine thin)
  • Salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, paprika
  • 4–6 oz cream cheese
  • Shredded Monterey Jack cheese

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
  2. In a 9x13 casserole dish, add rice, chicken broth, salsa verde, black beans, and corn. Stir to combine.
  3. Nestle chicken into the dish and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, cumin, and paprika. Top with cream cheese.
  4. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 45–50 minutes. (Cook time will vary depending on your dish, rice, chicken size, and how tightly it’s covered—always check that chicken reaches 165°F.)
  5. Remove from oven, shred chicken, and stir everything together.
  6. Top with shredded Monterey Jack cheese and bake or broil for 5–10 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

5-Ingredient Triple Berry Crisp with Frozen Berries

Effortless and delicious 5-Ingredient Triple Berry Crisp, crafted with frozen mixed berries and a simple, wholesome crisp topping! This fruit crisp is not only simple to make, but also easy to adapt to a variety of diets, making it a perfect treat for any occasion. Serve it warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for a delicious and healthy dessert!

Serves 8Prep 10 minCook 40 minTotal 50 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 4 cups frozen mixed berries
  • 1/4 cup cane sugar (or coconut sugar)
  • 1/4 cup gluten-free all purpose flour (or regular all purpose flour)
  • 1/2 tablespoon lemon juice (optional)
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract (optional)
  • 1 cup rolled oats
  • 3/4 cup gluten-free all purpose flour (or almond flour)
  • 1/2 cup cane sugar (or coconut sugar)
  • 6 ounces butter (cut into 1-inch cubes)

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350° Fahrenheit.
  2. Add all berry ingredients to a 9-inch baking dish and toss together until evenly coated, then spread the berries into an even layer around the dish.
  3. Add all crisp ingredients to a large bowl. Use a fork to mix together, until a crumbly mixture forms. Sprinkled the crisp topping evenly over the berries.
  4. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the berries are super soft, then let cool slightly before serving with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. YUM!

Sloppy Joe Sweet Potato Boats

Tender roasted sweet potatoes, homemade sloppy joe filling, and melted mozzarella come together in these Sloppy Joe Sweet Potato Boats for a comforting dinner with a balanced twist. They're an easy high-protein meal that's great for weeknight dinners, meal prep, or anyone looking for a healthier take on a nostalgic family favorite.

Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 35 minTotal 50 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 medium sweet potatoes, (sliced lengthwise into 1-inch slices)
  • 1 lb ground beef
  • 1 tbsp avocado oil
  • 1/2 small yellow onion, (diced)
  • 1 green bell pepper, (diced)
  • 3/4 cup ketchup
  • 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce
  • 2 tbsp brown sugar
  • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
  • 1 tbsp dijon mustard
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1/2 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp black pepper
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 6-8 oz shredded mozzarella cheese
  • Pickle slices
  • Pickled red onion
  • Pickled jalapeños

Steps

  1. Start by preheating your oven to 400℉.
  2. Poke holes with a fork into both of your sweet potatoes. Place in the microwave for 2 minutes. This will make the cutting process much easier.
  3. Once out of the microwave, slice the sweet potato into 1-inch thick slices lengthwise. I usually get about 4-5 slices of each sweet potato. Add to a baking sheet, spray with some avocado oil, and season with some salt and pepper. Place in the oven for 20-25 minutes until they can easily be pierced with a fork.
  4. Meanwhile, prep the sloppy joe meat mixture. Preheat a large pan to medium-high heat. Add the avocado oil and then the ground beef. Cook for 7-10 minutes until fully cooked.
  5. Once the meat has cooked, add the diced bell pepper and onion. Saute for 3-5 minutes until soft.
  6. Next, add the ketchup, worcestershire, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, dijon mustard, and seasonings. Mix well and bring to a low simmer. Simmer for 5-10 minutes until the sweet potatoes are ready. Taste the mixture and add salt and pepper as necessary.
  7. Once the sweet potatoes are done, place the cooked meat mixture on top of the sweet potatoes and sprinkle with cheese. Put them back in the oven for about 5 minutes until the cheese melts.
  8. Broil for the last minute or so until the cheese starts to get brown.
  9. Serve immediately with your favorite toppings! I chose some pickled red onions and pickled jalapenos. Enjoy!

Source: Cailee Eats

ABC Baby Muffins (Apple, Banana and Carrot!)

These are deliberately very moist (and moister than regular muffins) to ensure they are easy for baby to chew and swallow, so expect that from the interior. They have three types of produce in the mix and are a yummy breakfast or snack.

Serves 12Prep 10 minCook 16 minTotal 26 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup mashed very ripe banana ((about 2-3 small bananas))
  • ½ cup shredded apple ((about 1 small apple))
  • ¼ cup shredded carrot ((about 1 small carrot))
  • ¾ cup milk
  • ¼ cup melted unsalted butter ((slightly cooled))
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
  • 1 cup whole wheat flour
  • ½ cup rolled oats
  • 1 teaspoon cinnamon
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon baking soda
  • ⅛ teaspoon salt

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 375 degree F and grease a 24 cup mini muffin pan with nonstick spray.
  2. Place the banana, apple, carrot, milk, butter, egg, and vanilla into a medium bowl. Stir together.
  3. Gently, but thoroughly, stir in the flour, oats, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
  4. Divide batter among the prepared muffin pan, filling each cup to the edge. (You'll use about 2 tablespoons batter in each mini muffin cup).
  5. Bake for 16-20 minutes or until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out cleanly. (I do 18 minutes in my oven.)
  6. Let cool for a few minutes in the pan, then transfer to a wire rack to cool fully. Dice up to serve to a baby eating finger foods or offer one whole to a baby eating baby led weaning-style foods.

Source: Yummy Toddler Food

Ingredients

Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies

Soft and chewy Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies made with ripe bananas, rich brown butter, and melty dark chocolate chips. Sweet banana flavor, buttery taste, and gooey centers make these cookies warm, cozy, and irresistible.

Serves 12Prep 15 minCook 12 minTotal 57 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 sticks butter (browned)
  • ⅔ cup coconut sugar (or light brown sugar)
  • 2 egg yolks
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • ⅔ cup mashed ripe bananas
  • 2 ⅔ cup gluten free flour (see note)
  • 1 tsp baking soda
  • ½ tsp sea salt
  • 1 cup dark chocolate chips

Steps

  1. First, brown the butter. Place the two sticks of butter in a skillet over low medium heat. Stir occasionally, until the butter has turned a golden brown color.
  2. Remove from the heat and set aside.
  3. In a large mixing bowl, combine the gluten free flour, baking soda, sea salt, and coconut sugar. Stir to combine.
  4. Then, add in the brown butter, egg yolks, vanilla, and mashed banana. Stir together.
  5. Fold in the chocolate chips.
  6. Place the bowl in your fridge for 30 to 45 minutes.
  7. After that, preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Line a pan with parchment paper.
  8. Use a cookie scoop to scoop out balls of dough. Leave at least 3 inches of space between each dough ball.
  9. Bake for 12 to 13 minutes. The cookies will look very gooey still. Remove from the oven and allow these cookies to cool for 15 minutes on the pan.
  10. Finally, carefully remove to a cooling rack. Top with flaky sea salt if desired.

Banana Oatmeal Muffins (SO Good!)

With just a handful of nutritious ingredients, you can bake up super easy Banana Oatmeal Muffins to share with the kids. For the best flavor and sweetness, use bananas with a lot of brown spots. Bonus: These store so well in the fridge for days!

Serves 10Prep 10 minCook 20 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 cups rolled oats
  • 2 cups sliced bananas ((about 2 medium, very ripe) )
  • 6 ounces milk ((or plain whole-milk Greek yogurt))
  • ⅓ cup maple syrup
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 teaspoon cinnamon
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • ¼ cup chocolate chips ((optional))
  • ½ teaspoon salt

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F and grease 10 cups of a standard-size muffin tin.
  2. Place the oats into a food processor or blender. Grind for about 30 seconds or until they resemble a coarse flour.
  3. Add the rest of the ingredients except the chocolate chips, if using.
  4. Blend until very smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides of the blender if needed.
  5. Divide among 10 muffin cups. You want each cup to be about 3/4 full. Top with chocolate chips if using.
  6. Bake for 20-22 minutes or until firm to the touch and lightly golden brown around the edges. Let cool in the pan for 5-10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack (or just tilt a bit in the pan to let air flow underneath) to cool.
  7. Serve warm, at room temperature, or chilled.

Bang Bang Chicken Bowls

30 minute bang bang chicken bowls 👩🏼‍🍳❤️‍🔥🤤 what you’ll need:

Serves 6Prep 20 minCook 10 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs chicken thighs, (cubed)
  • 2 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tbsp avocado oil
  • 1/3 cup mayo
  • 3 tbsp sriracha
  • 1/4 cup Thai sweet chili sauce
  • 1 tsp rice vinegar
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • Served with cauliflower rice or regular rice
  • Cabbage slaw
  • Freshly sliced green onions

Steps

  1. Cut the chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes and place them in a large bowl. Add the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Toss until the chicken is evenly coated.
  2. Preheat a pan over medium-high heat and drizzle in a little avocado oil. Once hot, add the chicken and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and golden on the edges.
  3. While the chicken cooks, make the bang bang sauce. In a small bowl, mix together the mayo, sriracha, Thai sweet chili sauce, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Taste and adjust by adding more chili sauce if you like extra heat or sweetness.
  4. Once the chicken is cooked through, pour in all but a few tablespoons of the sauce and stir to coat. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken and get slightly crispy around the edges.
  5. To assemble, start with a base of cauliflower rice or regular rice. Add a handful of cabbage slaw, then spoon the bang bang chicken on top. Drizzle with the reserved sauce and garnish with sliced green onions. Enjoy!

Ingredients

  • 3/4 cup light brown sugar (packed)

  • 2 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or extract
  • 2 cups 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour

  • 1/2 teaspoon salt

Steps

  5. Fold in your chocolate chips.
  6. Wrap your bowl and let the dough chill in the refrigerator 2-24 hrs.
  7. Scoop and roll dough in your hands into your preferred cookie size and roll into balls. Place on prepared baking sheets, spacing about 2 inches apart.
  8. Preheat the oven to 375F and bake for 11 minutes. Once they are done baking, remove and let them sit on the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

Steps

  1. 18 low carb, high protein bagels (I like Dave’s Killer):
  2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray with cooking spray
  3. Whisk eggs, cottage cheese, a dash of salt and pepper, and garlic powder
  4. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and add sausage. Cook until browned, remove from heat and set aside. To the same pan, add onions and cook 5-7 mins. Add spinach and cook another 1 min. Remove from heat. Stir sausage and veggies into the egg mixture, then pour into the baking sheet. Bake 15 mins or until eggs are set
  5. Slice and sandwich between bagel rounds. Add a slice of cheese to each and fold each one in parchment paper or foil. Freeze! Move from freezer to refrigerate when ready to eat for the week. Microwave for about 30 secs when ready to eat!

Breakfast Enchiladas

Tender eggs, gooey cheese and savory sausage wrapped in a flour tortilla and smothered in enchilada sauce make this a must-try breakfast recipe.

Serves 12Prep 20 minCook 45 minTotal 65 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 16 ounces mild sausage
  • 1 medium onion (diced)
  • 1 tsp minced garlic
  • ½ tsp red pepper flakes
  • 1 cup cottage cheese
  • 8 large eggs
  • 2 cups southern-style hash browns
  • 2 cups Monterey Jack cheese (shredded)
  • 10 ounces green enchilada sauce (divided)
  • 1 tsp black pepper
  • 1 tsp salt
  • ¾ cup heavy cream
  • 6-8 flour tortillas
  • ½ cup bacon bits

Steps

  1. In a pan over medium to high heat add your sausage, diced onion, minced garlic, and red pepper flakes. When sausage is halfway cooked add the hash browns to the pan.
  2. Cook the sausage until fully browned. Remove the pan from the heat and gently fold in the cottage cheese to your hash brown and sausage mixture.
  3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, salt, pepper, and half of the can of enchilada sauce. Set aside the remaining enchilada sauce.
  4. Fill tortillas with the sausage mixture and a small amount of shredded cheese. Roll and place each filled tortilla seam-side down in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
  5. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the enchiladas. Spoon any remaining meat mixture on top of the dish.
  6. When ready to bake, pre-heat the oven to 350 F. Top the baking dish with any remaining enchilada sauce. Sprinkle with remaining shredded cheese and bacon bits
  7. Place dish in the oven and allow to bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes or until the eggs are set and edges of enchiladas are golden.
  8. Remove pan from the oven and serve enchiladas warm with toppings like sour cream, avocado and salsa. Enjoy!

Brown Butter Cinnamon Rolls

These brown butter cinnamon rolls are the perfect Fall twist on one of my favorite recipes! Brown butter is used in both the dough and filling, and of course, it's all topped with a brown butter cream cheese icing. It's a drool-worthy combination that's sure to become a Fall staple!

Serves 12Prep 30 minCook 26 minTotal 66 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 cups butter unsalted, cold and cut into Tbsp-sized pieces (454g)
  • 4 cups all-purpose flour (520g)
  • 4 1/2 tsp (2 packets) instant dry yeast (14g, 1/2 oz.)
  • 1 tsp fine salt (6g)
  • 1 cup whole milk (240g)
  • 1/2 cup brown butter, melted (113g)
  • 1/2 cup granulated sugar (100g)
  • 2 large eggs, room temperature (112g)
  • 3/4 cup brown butter, melted (170g)
  • 1 1/4 cups packed light brown sugar (250g)
  • 2 Tbsp ground cinnamon
  • 1/2 tsp fine salt
  • 1/4 cup heavy cream - to be added later (45g)
  • 1/4 cup brown butter, room temperature (56g)
  • 1/4 cup cream cheese, room temperature (56g)
  • 2 tsp vanilla extract or vanilla bean paste (10g)
  • 1/4 tsp fine salt
  • 1 cup powdered sugar (125g)
  • 2 Tbsp heavy cream or milk, room temperature (30g)

Steps

  1. The first step is to brown the butter. Get a heatproof bowl out to pour the butter into once it's browned. Then place 2 cups of unsalted butter in a large, light-colored frying pan (to make it easier to see) over medium heat. Stir the butter the entire time with a rubber spatula to prevent the milk solids from burning!
  2. Once melted, the butter will begin to foam and sizzle around the edges. Keep stirring!! The butter should turn golden brown after 5–6 minutes and be topped with a foamy layer of bubbles. Shortly after this, the foam should kind of fade away, and the milk solids at the bottom of the pan will be a perfectly toasted brown. It should have a strong, nutty aroma.
  3. Immediately remove the pan from heat and pour the butter into a heatproof bowl to stop the cooking process. If left in the hot pan, the milk solids will burn. It can happen in a flash, trust me!! Set aside.
  4. In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, combine 4 cups of flour, 2 packets of instant dry yeast, and 1 tsp fine salt.
  5. In a separate bowl, combine 1 cup milk, 1/2 cup melted brown butter, and 1/2 cup granulated sugar. Heat for 30-60 seconds in the microwave and stir to combine the ingredients. The mixture should be warm but not hot to the touch (otherwise it can kill the yeast!).
  6. Slowly pour the warm milk mixture into the flour mixture and mix on medium-low speed with a dough hook or by hand. Scrape around the edges with a rubber spatula to make sure all the flour gets incorporated.
  7. Add 2 large eggs, one at a time. Mix on medium speed until a sticky dough ball forms. Continue to mix the dough on medium speed for a couple of minutes until the dough becomes more elastic and looks smooth.
  8. Then mix in additional flour, 1 Tbsp at a time, on a low speed until the dough is tacky but no longer sticky (I usually add 1-2 additional Tbsp of flour). It should pull away/no longer stick to the sides of your mixing bowl once it's ready to rest. Another way to test the dough is to tap it with your finger. It should be tacky, but shouldn't stick to your finger or leave any residue on your finger.
  9. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and set aside to let the dough rest for 10-20 minutes to allow the gluten to relax. This will make it easier to roll out.
  10. While the dough rests, make the cinnamon roll filling. Add 3/4 cup melted brown butter, 1 1/4 cups packed brown sugar, 2 Tbsp ground cinnamon, and 1/2 tsp fine salt to a medium-sized bowl. Mix together until combined, then set aside. The mixture should have a thick, paste-like consistency. Set aside.
  11. Preheat the oven to 200°F/93°C (to help the cinnamon rolls rise), and line a metal 9x13-inch pan. If you're making these the day before, don't preheat the oven. Set aside.
  12. Place the dough on a lightly floured surface and roll it into a large rectangle that's about 24 in x 18 in. Spread 2/3 of the filling in a thin layer across the dough with an offset spatula or butter knife.
  13. Mix 1/4 cup of heavy cream into the remaining filling, then spread it onto the bottom of the prepared 9x13-inch pan to give the cinnamon rolls deliciously sticky bottoms.
  14. Use a rolling pastry cutter or pizza cutter to cut 12 equal strips that are about 2" wide - this is why it's important that the dough is 24" wide! If it's shorter, you may need to cut your strips a bit narrower. Then roll each cinnamon roll up individually. Place them in the prepared 9 in x 13 in pan. You can also roll the dough into a log and cut each piece with a knife or dental floss if you prefer!
  15. If you are making these cinnamon rolls the night before, cover the cinnamon rolls tightly with plastic wrap and place them in the fridge overnight. The following morning, take them out of the fridge and preheat the oven to 200°F/93°C. Then turn off the oven, cover the rolls with foil, and place the rolls in the oven for about 30 minutes, until they've risen.
  16. If you make these the morning of, turn off the oven, cover the rolls with foil, and place them in the oven to rise for about 30 minutes. MAKE SURE YOU'VE TURNED THE OVEN OFF. We want a nice cozy place for the rolls to rise, but we don't want to bake them yet.
  17. At this point, they should look puffier and have grown about twice in size. Preheat the oven to 350°F/175°C. Then bake the rolls for 24-28 minutes, or until they're just starting to brown. Rotate the pan halfway through to help them bake evenly.
  18. While the cinnamon rolls rise and bake, make the brown butter cream cheese icing. Mix 1/4 cup softened brown butter, 1/4 cup room-temperature cream cheese, 2 tsp vanilla extract, and 1/4 tsp salt together with a spoon or electric hand mixer.
  19. Then mix in 1 cup of powdered sugar and 2 Tbsp of heavy cream or milk at a low speed until it is smooth.
  20. Let the cinnamon rolls cool for about 10 minutes, then spoon the icing over them and enjoy warm! Store any leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for a few hours, or in the fridge for up to 5 days.

Source: Chelsweets

Brown Butter Oreo M&M Chip Cookies (Soft, Chewy, Bakery Style)

These brown butter Oreo M&M chip cookies are soft, chewy, and packed with flavor. Made with browned butter, crushed Oreos, M&Ms, and chocolate chips for the ultimate cookie.

Serves 24Prep 50 minCook 8 minTotal 60 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup unsalted butter
  • 1 1/4 cups light brown sugar
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 large egg
  • 2 large egg yolks
  • 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
  • 2 1/4 cups all purpose flour
  • 1 tablespoon cornstarch (optional)
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon fine grain salt
  • 1/2 cup crushed Oreos
  • 1/2 cup M&Ms
  • 1/2 cup semi sweet chocolate chips
  • 1/4 cup sprinkles (optional)

Steps

  1. Add butter to a saucepan over low to medium heat and brown, stirring constantly. Remove from heat once golden and nutty. Let cool slightly.
  2. In a large bowl, mix brown butter with brown sugar and granulated sugar for 2 minutes.
  3. Add egg, egg yolks, and vanilla extract and mix until combined.
  4. Fold in flour, cornstarch (if using), baking powder, and salt until just combined.
  5. Fold in Oreos, M&Ms, chocolate chips, and sprinkles if using.
  6. Refrigerate dough for 30 minutes.
  7. Scoop into 24 balls and place on a lined baking sheet.
  8. Bake at 350°F for 9 to 11 minutes until edges are set and centers are soft.
  9. Cool and enjoy.

Ingredients

  • vanilla sugar or coarse sugar, for sprinkling ((optional))
  • 4 tablespoons salted butter
  • 1 cup light or dark brown sugar
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 egg yolk
  • 1/3 cup maple syrup
  • 1/3 cup heavy cream
  • 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
  • 1 - 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips or chunks
  • flaky sea salt
  • 1 cup heavy cream

Steps

  1. 1. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven. Preheat the oven to 350° F.2. Fit the pie crust into an 8-inch pie plate. Brush the edges of the crust with beaten egg, then sprinkle with vanilla sugar (or coarse sugar). Lightly prick the bottom of the dough with a fork. Freeze 10 minutes.3. Meanwhile, add the butter to a small saucepan set over medium heat, cook until the butter begins to brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer to a heatproof bowl. Let cool.4. Whisk together the brown sugar and 2 eggs, and 1 egg yolk until well combined. Add the maple syrup and cream. Whisk in the brown butter and vanilla until smooth. Fold in the chocolate chips. Pour the mixture into the crust.5. Bake for 55-60 minutes, until the pie is puffed on top, but still wiggly in the center. The longer you bake, the more set your pie will be. Remove from the oven and let cool 20-30 minutes, then serve the pie warm, sprinkled with sea salt (if desired), and dolloped with whip cream. Or serve are room temp. Both options are great! 6. To make the whipped cream, whip the cream using an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Add the maple syrup and vanilla. Whip until combined and fluffy.

Brownie Pie

Rich, fudgy, and totally decadent. This Brownie Pie layers chewy cookie dough with intense dark chocolate brownie. It’s a thick, gooey treat with a buttery finish and plenty of chocolate chips. Simple ingredients, amazing taste!

Serves 12Prep 20 minCook 40 minTotal 60 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • ½ cup melted butter
  • 1 cup dark chocolate chips
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 cup coconut sugar
  • 2 tbsp dark cocoa powder
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • ¼ cup gluten free flour
  • ½ cup dark chocolate chips (to mix in)
  • ½ cup cold unsalted butter
  • ¾ cup coconut sugar
  • 1 egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 ¼ cups gluten free flour
  • ½ tsp baking soda
  • pinch sea salt
  • ½ cup chocolate chips

Steps

  1. First, preheat your oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Spray a pie plate with nonstick spray.
  2. Make the cookie dough. In a large mixing bowl, add cold butter and coconut sugar. Mix on high until no clumps of butter remain, about 2 to 3 minutes.
  3. Then, add in egg and vanilla. Stir to combine.
  4. Add in flour, baking soda and sea salt. Stir to combine.
  5. Fold in chocolate chips. Press this mixture into the oiled pie plate. It should be no thicker than ½ inch.
  6. Then, make the brownie batter.
  7. Add melted butter and 1 cup dark chocolate chips to a bowl. Stir until creamy and fully melted. If needed, microwave for 10 to 15 seconds. Set aside.
  8. In a mixing bowl, add eggs and sugar. Whisk vigorously for 2 to 3 minutes, until light and frothy.
  9. Add the melted chocolate mixture to the mixing bowl. Stir to combine.
  10. Then, add in dark cocoa powder, vanilla, flour and espresso powder. Stir to combine.
  11. Fold in extra chocolate chips if desired.
  12. Pour batter into the pie plate on top of the cookie dough. Smooth out into one even layer.
  13. Bake for 36 to 40 minutes, or until the edges are set and the middle is no longer jiggly.
  14. Finally, remove from the oven. Cool for at least 4 hours before slicing and serving.

Cheesy Potato and Beef Skillet

Rich, hearty, and easy to make, it's the perfect recipe for busy weeknights, cozy weekends, or anytime you're craving classic comfort food.

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 lb ground beef
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • 1 small yellow onion, (finely diced)
  • 4 small yukon gold potatoes, (sliced thinly with mandolin)
  • 2 cups milk
  • 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 2 tsp dried rosemary
  • 1 cup shredded white cheddar cheese
  • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
  • Fresh green onions, (sliced)

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 350℉.
  2. First, make the cream for the potatoes. Preheat an oven-safe pan to medium heat. Add the milk, onion powder, garlic powder, and dried rosemary. Stir everything together and bring to a simmer. Let it simmer for a few minutes, then add the parmesan cheese. Mix until the cheese has melted.
  3. Turn off the heat, remove the cream from the pan, and place it into a bowl. Leave just a little bit of the cream in the bottom of the pan.
  4. Add a layer of thinly sliced potatoes, then a layer of cream. Repeat until all the potatoes and cream are gone.
  5. Cover with foil and place in the oven for 50 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked and can easily be pierced with a fork.
  6. While the potatoes are cooking, make the ground beef mixture. Add the ground beef and cook for 7-10 minutes until brown. Add the diced onions and ground beef seasoning and saute for a few more minutes until the onions are soft.
  7. Once the potatoes are out of the oven, top with the ground beef mixture and shredded cheese.
  8. Place back into the oven and broil for 3-5 minutes until the cheese is golden brown. Top with sliced green onion and serve immediately. Enjoy!

Ingredients

  • 1/2 bell pepper, diced
  • 1 lb ground beef
  • 2 packets taco seasoning
  • 1 (10-ounce) can Rotel, undrained
  • 5 cups beef broth
  • 1 lb spaghetti, broken in half
  • 4 ounces cream cheese, softened
  • 1 cup freshly shredded Colby Jack cheese
  • 1/3 cup sour cream
  • Optional Toppings:
  • Sliced green onions
  • Additional shredded Colby Jack cheese

Steps

  1. In a large skillet, cook the ground beef, diced onion, and bell pepper until the beef is browned and the vegetables are tender. Drain any excess grease.
  2. Stir in the taco seasoning, Rotel, and beef broth. Mix well to combine.
  3. Add the spaghetti noodles, breaking them in half if needed. Press the noodles down so they are fully submerged in the liquid.
  4. Cover and bring the mixture to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cook according to the pasta package directions, stirring 2–3 times throughout cooking to prevent the noodles from sticking.
  5. When the pasta is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, stir in the cream cheese, shredded Colby Jack cheese, and sour cream. Mix until the cheese is melted and the sauce is creamy.
  6. Top with sliced green onions and additional Colby Jack cheese, if desired, and serve warm.

Chewy Pumpkin Cookies

These chewy pumpkin cookies have the perfect amount of pumpkin spice and each bite truly melts in your mouth. With chewy centers and spiced sugar topping, you will not believe how delicious these fall cookies are!

Serves 18Prep 30 minCook 12 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1/4 cup (50 g) granulated white sugar
  • 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
  • 3/4 cup (168 g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1 cup (220 g) light brown sugar, packed
  • 2 egg yolks, at room temperature
  • 2 tsp vanilla
  • 1/2 cup (122 g) canned pumpkin puree (Libby's works best)
  • 1 3/4 cups (219 g) all purpose flour, spooned and leveled
  • 1 tbsp pumpkin pie spice
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt

Steps

  1. In a small bowl mix the granulated sugar and pumpkin pie spice together. Set aside.
  2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
  3. Start by drying your pumpkin. (This step is not optional. The cookies will not bake properly if you skip this step.) Spread the canned pumpkin on a plate and lightly press with a paper towel to absorb the excess liquid. Repeat the step at least four more times. The pumpkin should be dry enough that it goes from being 1/2 cup dried down to just about a 1/4 cup. Hardly any liquid should transfer onto a paper towel once it has been dried enough.(Like stated above, try to use Libby's canned pumpkin as almost all cans of it have the same consistency and are not too wet.) Then set aside.
  4. In a small bowl, whisk together the flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Set aside.
  5. In a large bowl cream the softened butter and brown sugar together with an electric mixer on high speed for 1-2 minutes until light and fluffy.
  6. Add in the egg yolks and vanilla and mix on medium speed until pale and fluffy, about 1-2 minutes.
  7. Add in the pumpkin and mix on medium-low speed to combine.
  8. Add in the dry ingredients and mix on low speed just until combined.
  9. Scoop the dough with a 2 tbsp cookie scoop, and roll them into balls. Then roll the dough balls in the spiced sugar. (If the dough is too "sticky" chill it in the fridge for 10 minutes, then proceed.)
  10. Place the cookie dough balls at least 2 inches apart on the baking sheets. (I usually bake 6 at a time.)
  11. Bake the cookies for 12-14 minutes. (12 minutes for really chewy centers, 14 minutes for a slightly crispier cookie). When the cookies are done baking the centers will be puffy. As they cool the centers will fall and the cookie will get "wrinkly".
  12. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a cooling rack to finish cooling. They are best enjoyed when they have cooled for at least 15 minutes!

Source: In Bloom Bakery

Ingredients

  • For the Roll Ups:
  • 10–12 lasagna noodles
  • 2 cups cooked chicken (rotisserie or leftover) see note
  • 1 block Boursin cheese
  • 1 cup ricotta cheese
  • 1 egg
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp black pepper
  • 1 tsp garlic & herb seasoning @Fire & Smoke Society
  • 1 tsp parsley
  • For the Alfredo Sauce:
  • 1 stick butter
  • 1 tbsp minced garlic
  • 2 cups heavy whipping cream
  • 1 1/4 cups freshly grated Parmesan cheese
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp black pepper
  • Toppings:
  • 2 cups shredded mozzarella
  • Parsley (optional)

Steps

  1. Cook the noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and lay flat on parchment paper or foil so they don’t stick.
  2. Make the filling: In a bowl, combine Boursin cheese, ricotta, egg, garlic powder, black pepper, garlic & herb seasoning, and parsley. Mix until fully combined.
  3. Make the Alfredo sauce: In a skillet or saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in Parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper until smooth and creamy.
  4. Assemble: Spread 1/2 cup Alfredo sauce into the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking dish. Spoon the cheese mixture onto each lasagna noodle, followed by a spoon of chicken, then roll tightly. Place seam-side down in the dish.
  5. Top it off: Pour remaining Alfredo sauce over the roll ups. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese.
  6. Bake: Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 3 minutes on low broil until bubbly and golden.
  7. Finish: Garnish with parsley and let rest 5 minutes before serving.

  9. Slice and enjoy!

Christmas Sugar Cookie Bars

These Christmas Sugar Cookie Bars are everything you love about classic sugar cookies (soft, sweet, buttery, and full of holiday sprinkles) but without all the rolling and cutting. They bake in one pan and are topped with creamy vanilla frosting. A perfect, low-stress, nostalgic treat for holiday parties and cookie exchanges!

Serves 24Prep 20 minCook 18 minTotal 78 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup unsalted butter (softened to room temperature)
  • 4 oz cream cheese (softened to room temperature)
  • 1 ½ cups granulated sugar
  • 1 large egg (room temperature)
  • 1 large egg yolk (room temperature)
  • 1 Tbsp. vanilla extract
  • 1/4 tsp almond extract (optional)
  • 2 ½ cups all-purpose flour (spooned & leveled)
  • 1 Tbsp. cornstarch
  • ¾ tsp. baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp. fine salt
  • 1/8 tsp. baking soda
  • 1/8 cup Christmas sprinkles (jimmies, plus more for garnish)
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter (softened to room temperature)
  • 1 tsp. vanilla extract
  • 1/4 tsp almond extract (optional)
  • 1/4 tsp salt (or to taste)
  • 2 cups powdered sugar (sifted)
  • 1 ½ Tbsp heavy cream (room temperature; add more as needed)
  • food coloring (optional)
  • additional Christmas sprinkles (for decorating)

Steps

  1. Preheat Oven: Preheat to 325°F. Spray a 9×13-inch pan with non stick spray, and then line with parchment paper. This makes it easy for the parchment to stick to the pan when you spread the bars later on.
  2. Cream Butter, Cream Cheese & Sugar: In a large mixing bowl or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter, cream cheese, and granulated sugar together on medium speed until light and creamy, about 2–3 minutes. Start Timer
  3. Add Wet Ingredients: Mix in the egg, egg yolk, vanilla, and almond extract (if using) until smooth and well combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.
  4. Add Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and baking soda. Gradually add to the wet ingredients on low speed until a soft dough forms. It will be pretty soft, and not like a normal dry-ish cookie dough texture. We want soft, that’s good!
  5. Add sprinkles: Fold in the Christmas sprinkles.
  6. Spread and Bake: Press the dough evenly into the prepared pan with an offset spatula. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden and the center looks just set. (It’s crucial for these bars to not overbake, they’ll continue to firm as they cool and we want them soft and chewy!) Start Timer
  7. Cool: Allow bars to cool completely in the pan on a wire rack before frosting.
  8. Make the Frosting: In a medium bowl, beat the butter until smooth. Add the vanilla, almond extract (if using), and salt. Gradually mix in the powdered sugar until combined, then add the heavy cream and beat for 1-2 minutes until light and fluffy. Tint with food coloring, if desired. (Example: A couple drops of red for a pretty pink color, or green for Christmas)
  9. Frost & Decorate: Spread frosting evenly over cooled cookie bars and top with additional sprinkles. Slice into squares and enjoy!

Chuck Roast Elote Tacos Ingredients For the Chuck Roast • 3–4 lb chuck roast • Coarse salt • Coarse black pepper For the Elote Corn • 3 cups frozen corn • 1–2 tbsp oil • ¼ cup sour cream • ¼ cup mayonnaise • ½ tsp chili powder • ½ tsp garlic powder • Salt, to taste For Assembly • Corn tor

Serves 6

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • For the Chuck Roast
  • 3–4 lb chuck roast
  • Coarse salt
  • Coarse black pepper
  • For the Elote Corn
  • 3 cups frozen corn
  • 1–2 tbsp oil
  • 1/4 cup sour cream
  • 1/4 cup mayonnaise
  • 1/2 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • Salt, to taste
  • For Assembly
  • Corn tortillas
  • Avocado mayo (or sliced avocado mayo)
  • Queso fresco, crumbled
  • Fresh cilantro, chopped

Steps

  1. Cook the Chuck Roast
  2. Preheat the oven to 325°F. Season the roast generously on all sides with coarse salt and coarse pepper. Place it in a baking dish, cover tightly with foil, and bake for about 1 hour per pound, until tender and shreddable.
  3. Shred & Broil
  4. Remove the foil, shred the roast, and toss the meat in the rendered fat. Spread the shredded beef on the pan and broil for a few minutes until the edges are crispy.
  5. Char the Elote Corn:
  6. Heat a large pan over high heat with a little oil. Add frozen corn in a single layer and cook for about 3 minutes without touching it to develop char. Toss, then cook another 1–2 minutes. Stir in sour cream, mayo, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt.
  7. Toast the Tortillas
  8. Warm or lightly toast corn tortillas in a dry pan until soft and slightly crisp around the edges.
  9. Assemble the Tacos
  10. Spread a little avocado mayo on each tortilla, add crispy chuck roast, spoon the elote corn on top, and finish with queso fresco and fresh cilantro.

  • 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast

  2. Stir in 1½ tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp ground turmeric, a few shakes of freshly ground black pepper, and 1 tsp salt.
  3. Add chicken, 1 bag diced sweet potatoes, 2 medium sliced carrots, and 1 diced yellow onion. Gently stir to coat everything in the sauce.
  4. Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6–7 hours.
  5. Remove the chicken, shred with two forks, and return it to the crockpot.
  6. Stir in 1 sliced red bell pepper, cover, and cook on high for 10 more minutes until the peppers are tender yet still have a little crunch.
  7. Serve over jasmine rice or cauliflower rice, and top with chopped parsley if desired.
  8. Enjoy!

Cream Cheese Sugar Cookies

This is the best sugar cookie recipe for Christmas! These cream cheese sugar cookies bake into a deliciously soft and buttery texture, but still hold their shape when baked. The dough only chills for one hour, or it can be prepped the day before and chill overnight. Spread some cream cheese buttercream on top for easy decorating. It dries firm, so these cookies can be stacked and stored - a must f

Serves 26Prep 2 hr Cook 10 minTotal 2 hr 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (224g) unsalted butter, room temperature
  • 6 oz (170g) full fat cream cheese, room temperature
  • 1 1/2 cups (300g) granulated sugar
  • 1 large egg + 1 egg yolk
  • 2 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp cream of tartar
  • 3 1/2 cups (450g) all-purpose flour, spooned and leveled, plus more for dusting
  • 1/2 cup (112g) unsalted butter, room temp
  • 2 oz full fat cream cheese, room temp
  • 2 cups (220g) powdered sugar, spooned and leveled
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Gel food coloring (optional)
  • Sprinkles, for decorating

Steps

  1. In a large bowl using a hand or stand mixer with the paddle attachment, mix the butter, cream cheese, and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 1 minute.
  2. Scrape down the bowl and mix in the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla until smooth.
  3. Scrape down the bowl and mix in the salt, baking powder, and cream of tartar until combined.
  4. Last, mix in the flour. When your mixer starts to struggle with the thick dough, remove from the mixer and use a rubber spatula to ensure the dough is well combined. It’s VERY thick and sticky, so this requires a little elbow grease!
  5. Dump the dough out onto a sheet of plastic wrap lightly dusted with flour.
  6. Coat your hands in flour and pat the dough out into a 1” thick rectangle. Wrap and chill for at least 1 hour or overnight.
  7. When ready, preheat the oven to 350F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
  8. Roll the dough out onto a floured surface to ¼” thick (we want nice and thick cookies).
  9. Cut out as many cookies as you can and place them about an inch apart on the baking sheet. With any leftover cut out cookies, store in the refrigerator.
  10. Bake for 8-10 minutes (9 was the sweet spot for me), or until they look dry on the surface but just barely done in the middle. In the meantime, you can re-roll the dough scraps, continuing to store any cut out cookies in the refrigerator until it’s time to bake them.
  11. Let the cookies rest on the pan for about a minute, then transfer to a cooling rack before baking the rest of the batch.
  12. In a large bowl using a hand or stand mixer with the paddle attachment, mix the butter and cream cheese until smooth.
  13. Mix in the powdered sugar one cup at a time, followed by the vanilla. It should be thick and smooth. Mix in a few drops of gel food coloring if desired.
  14. Spread the frosting on the cooled cookies and immediately top with sprinkles. If you wait too long, the sprinkles won’t stick so frost one cookie, add sprinkles, then move on to the next.
  15. Now they’re ready to enjoy!

Bakery-Style Chewy M&M Cookies

Ultra chewy cookies loaded with mini m&ms, deep dark brown sugar notes and a finish of flaky sea salt

Serves 12Prep 30 minCook 13 minTotal 43 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 1/4 cups All-purpose flour ((270 g))
  • 1/2 tsp Baking powder ((2 g))
  • 1/2 tsp Baking soda ((3 g))
  • 1 tsp Salt ((6 g))
  • 1 cup Unsalted butter ((226 g), room temperature)
  • 3/4 cup Dark brown sugar ((165 g), packed)
  • 2/3 cup Granulated sugar ((133 g))
  • 2 Large eggs (room temperature)
  • 1/2 tbsp Vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract ((7.5 ml))
  • 1 1/2 cups Mini M&Ms ((approx. 260 g), plus extra for placing on top)
  • Flaky sea salt (for finishing)

Steps

  1. Whisk the Dry Ingredients: In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until completely combined and free of lumps. Set this dry mixture aside.
  2. Cream the Butter and Sugars: In a large mixing bowl (or using a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), combine the room-temperature unsalted butter, packed dark brown sugar, and granulated sugar. Beat vigorously on medium-high speed for 2 to 3 minutes until the mixture is light, fluffy, and smooth.
  3. Incorporate Eggs and Vanilla: Add the room-temperature eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition to fully incorporate them. Add the vanilla bean paste (or vanilla extract) and beat until the mixture is thick, velvety, and uniform.
  4. Fold and Combine: Pour your dry ingredient mixture into the wet base. Using a wooden spoon or a rubber spatula, gently fold the ingredients together just until the flour disappears—do not overmix! Dump in your 1 1/2 cups of mini M&Ms and gently fold them into the cookie dough until evenly distributed.
  5. Weigh and Prep the Dough: Preheat your oven to 350°F (177°C). Using a digital kitchen scale, weigh out 2.5-ounce (approx. 70 g) dough balls. Roll them smoothly between your hands. For that absolute bakery-quality look, press extra mini M&Ms directly onto the tops of the dough balls before they go into the oven.
  6. Bake: Place dough balls on parchment-lined baking sheets, leaving about 2 to 3 inches of space between each cookie. Bake the cookies for 13 to 14 minutes. They are ready when the edges are a beautiful golden brown, but the insides are still slightly wet and soft.
  7. The Finishing Touch: The second you pull the baking sheet out of the oven, take more mini M&Ms and immediately fill in any empty spaces on top of the hot, soft cookies. Sprinkle generously with flaky sea salt while they are warm. Allow them to cool on the pan for 10 minutes to set before transferring them to a wire rack.

Cheesy Veggie Risoni (Orzo) – A Creamy, Kid-Friendly Comfort Meal

If you’re looking for a quick, easy, and veggie-packed meal that both kids and adults will love, this Cheesy Veggie Risoni is it! Also known as orzo, risoni is a small, rice-shaped pasta that cooks up creamy and comforting—perfect for little eaters and a great way to sneak in extra vegetables without a fuss. This recipe comes together in 20 minutes, and is loaded with veggies, including broccoli,

Prep 5 minCook 15 minTotal 20 min

Mom
Dad

Ingredients

  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1/2 cup finely chopped broccoli florrets
  • 1/2 cup carrot, finely grated
  • 1/2 cup finely choped or grated cauliflower
  • 1 clove garlic, crushed
  • 1/2 cup risoni (orzo)
  • 1 1/2 cups chicken or vegetable broth
  • 1 tablespoon sour cream
  • 1/4 cup cheddar or "tasty" cheese

Steps

  1. Prep the Veggies: Chop the broccoli into small pieces, finely shred the carrot, and grate or finely chop the cauliflower. These small sizes help them cook quickly and blend seamlessly into the dish.
  2. Sauté the Vegetables: In a medium pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the broccoli, carrot, cauliflower, and crushed garlic. Sauté for 5-6 minutes until softened and fragrant.
  3. Add risoni and chicken stock: Stir in ½ cup risoni (orzo) and 1 ½ cups chicken broth.
  4. Cook the Risoni: Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to medium-high. Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the risoni has absorbed most of the broth and is tender.
  5. Make It Creamy & Cheesy: Once the risoni is fully cooked and the broth has mostly absorbed, stir in sour cream and cheddar cheese. Mix until everything is smooth, creamy, and melted.
  6. Serve & Enjoy! Allow the dish to cool slightly before serving. Enjoy it on its own, or pair it with grilled chicken or fish for an extra boost of protein.

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Corn Orzo Ingredients * 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces * 2 tbsp Britscookin Cajun seasoning, divided (plus more to taste, if needed) * 1 tsp smoked paprika * Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp olive oil * 2 tbs

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
  • 2 tbsp Britscookin Cajun seasoning, divided (plus more to taste, if needed)
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • Fresh cracked black pepper, to taste

  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1 small yellow onion, diced
  • 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 16 oz orzo
  • 4 cups unsalted chicken broth (so you can control the sodium)
  • 1 (14.75 oz) can cream-style corn
  • 1 1/2 cups whole kernel corn (fresh, frozen, or canned and drained)

Steps

  1. Season the chicken thighs (or chicken breasts) with 1 tablespoon of the Cajun seasoning, the smoked paprika, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for 5–7 minutes, until nicely browned. Remove from the pan and set aside.
  2. Reduce the heat to medium. Add the butter, then the diced onion. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds, until fragrant.
  3. Add the dry orzo and stir constantly for 1–2 minutes to lightly toast it.
  4. Pour in the unsalted chicken broth, then stir in the cream-style corn and whole kernel corn. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan—they add tons of flavor.
  5. Return the browned chicken and any juices to the pan. Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of Cajun seasoning, then bring everything to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for about 10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.
  6. Stir in the heavy cream and freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Taste and adjust with additional Cajun seasoning, salt, and black pepper, if needed.
  7. Spoon into bowls and top with crispy bacon, sliced green onions, and a light sprinkle of smoked paprika.
  8. Using unsalted chicken broth gives you more control over the final seasoning.
  9. Let the orzo rest for about 5 minutes before serving. It will thicken slightly and become even creamier.

  3. 3 Add the dried parsley. Pour in a little less than half a bottle of Sauvignon Blanc (around 1 cup). Stir, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Let the wine bubble and reduce for 3-4 minutes.

Creamy Salmon Orzo Recipe (Boursin + Tomatoes)

A creamy, flavorful salmon orzo recipe made entirely in one pan for an easy weeknight dinner. Tender, seared and then oven-baked salmon is paired with perfectly cooked orzo, fresh spinach, and tomatoes, then tossed in a rich and herby Boursin cheese sauce for a comforting meal that’s ready in about 30 minutes.

Serves 4Prep 5 minCook 30 minTotal 35 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 4 salmon fillets (4-6oz each, approx. 1 inch thick)
  • kosher salt and ground black pepper
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1 pint cherry tomatoes
  • ⅓ cup yellow onion (diced)
  • 1 teaspoon garlic (minced)
  • 2 ¾ cups chicken broth (more as needed to thin sauce)
  • 1 ½ cups orzo
  • 1 ½ teaspoons kosher salt
  • 5.3 ounces Boursin Garlic and Fine Herbs Spreadable Cheese
  • 1 cup fresh spinach (chopped (more, if desired))
  • parmesan cheese (freshly shredded)

Steps

  1. Prep Oven: Preheat to 415℉.
  2. Prep Salmon: Pat 4 salmon fillets dry with paper towel and season with kosher salt and ground black pepper.
  3. Sear Salmon: Bring a large skillet or braiser to a medium-high heat (something oven safe with high sides). Drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil on the bottom. Once hot (flick water in the pan and it should sizzle), add the salmon fillets with the skin-side up. Sear for about 3-4 minutes.
  4. Bake: Flip salmon over and move the whole skillet to the oven to bake for 8-10 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 140-145℉. Remove the salmon from the pan (the skin may come off - that's okay) and set aside on a plate (discard skin).
  5. Sauté: Bring the skillet back to a medium heat and add 1 pint cherry tomatoes. Move around the pan for 1 minute. Add the diced onion and 1 teaspoon garlic. Sauté for 1-2 minutes or until softened.
  6. Cook Pasta: Add 2 ¾ cups chicken broth, 1 ½ cups orzo, and 1 ½ teaspoons kosher salt to the pan; mix to combine. Cover and cook for 8-10 minutes or until the orzo is almost fully cooked (be sure to scrape the bottom and stir frequently to prevent sticking while it cooks - add splashes of broth, if needed).
  7. Cheese + Spinach: Turn down the heat slightly, smash the tomatoes with the back of a fork, add 5.3 ounces Boursin Garlic and Fine Herbs Spreadable Cheese and chopped spinach to the pan. Mix to combine and let the cheese melt. Place the salmon back on top and let cook on a medium-low heat until the orzo is fully cooked.
  8. Serve: Enjoy immediately with some parmesan cheese on top!

Source: The Wooden Skillet

Creamy Shrimp Skillet

creamy street corn shrimp skillet 👩🏼‍🍳🤤🌽 What you’ll need: for the shrimp: 1 lb raw shrimp, peeled & deveined 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp each of salt & pepper for the creamy street corn sauce:

Serves 4Prep 10 minCook 15 minTotal 25 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 lb raw shrimp, (peeled & deveined)
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • ½ tsp smoked paprika
  • ½ tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 2 cups corn, (fresh, frozen, or canned)
  • 4 cloves garlic, (minced)
  • 2 jalapenos, (finely diced)
  • 1/2 cup low-fat cream cheese, (softened)
  • 1/3 cup crumbled cotija cheese
  • 1/2 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • Juice of 1 lime
  • 1/3 cup milk
  • 2 tbsp chopped cilantro
  • Extra cotija cheese
  • Cilantro, (freshly chopped)
  • Hot sauce
  • Sliced avocado, (optional)

Steps

  1. Toss shrimp with olive oil, chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
  2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Cook shrimp for 1-2 minutes per side, until they are just pink and opaque. Remove from skillet and set aside.
  3. In the same skillet, add butter. Sauté the corn, garlic, and jalapeño for 3-5 minutes, until the corn is slightly charred and fragrant.
  4. Reduce heat to medium-low. Stir in the cream cheese until it is melted and smooth. Add cotija, lime juice, and milk. Stir until sauce is creamy. Add more milk if you'd like it a bit more saucy!
  5. Let it simmer on low for a few minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Top with some extra cotija and a sprinkle of cilantro. Serve immediately. You can serve it as is, over rice, or cauliflower rice. Enjoy!

Source: Cailee Eats · Original post

Crispy Baked Chicken Wings

Crispy, golden, and packed with flavor, these baked chicken wings are surprisingly easy to make. You only need a few pantry spices and a hot oven for perfect results.

Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 40 minTotal 55 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 3 pounds chicken wings (split, tips removed)
  • 2 tablespoons butter (melted)
  • 2 teaspoons Diamond Crystal kosher salt
  • ½ teaspoon black pepper
  • 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1 teaspoon paprika (or smoked paprika)

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line two rimmed baking sheets with foil and fit them with oven-safe wire racks. You can also use parchment-lined baking sheets and skip the rack, but the racks do promote crispiness.
  2. Blot the wings completely dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, toss them with melted butter (you can also skip the butter and just sprinkle the blotted skin with the spices; this helps with crispiness). Arrange the wings in a single layer on the baking sheets, making sure they don't touch. Sprinkle them with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
  3. Bake the wings until they are cooked through and the skin is browned and crispy. Depending on your oven and the wings used, this should take about 30-40 minutes. See the notes section below for more tips.
  4. For extra-crispy skin, lower the oven temperature to 170°F and keep the wings in the cooling oven for 30-60 more minutes.
  5. Serve immediately. They pair well with blue cheese or ranch dressing.

Source: Healthy Recipes Blog

Crispy Baked Honey Sesame Chicken

crispy baked honey sesame chicken 🔥🍯🤤

Serves 6Prep 10 minCook 25 minTotal 35 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs chicken thighs, (cut into bite-sized pieces)
  • 1/2 cup cornstarch
  • 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1 egg, (beaten)
  • Spray oil
  • 1/3 cup honey
  • 1/4 cup soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp hoisin sauce
  • 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
  • 2 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 3 cloves garlic, (finely minced)
  • 1 tbsp ginger paste
  • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
  • 1-2 tbsp sriracha
  • 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water, (optional for thickening)
  • Toasted sesame seeds
  • Sliced green onions
  • Red pepper flakes

Steps

  1. Preheat your oven to 425℉. Add a baking rack to a large baking sheet and lightly spray with oil to keep the chicken from sticking.
  2. Add the cubed chicken, cornstarch, flour, seasoning, and the beaten egg in a large ziplock bag or Tupperware. Seal it tight with a lid and shake really well until the chicken is well coated.
  3. Place the chicken in an even layer on the baking rack and spray lightly with more oil. Bake for 15 minutes, flip, and cook another 10 minutes until fully cooked and crispy.
  4. Meanwhile, make the honey sesame sauce. Add all the sauce ingredients except the sesame seeds and cornstarch to a small pot. Turn the heat to medium low and whisk well. Let it come to a gentle simmer for a few minutes.
  5. If you'd like to make it thicker, add the cornstarch and water mixture and whisk constantly for 2-3 minutes until the sauce turns glossy. Once it's glossy, remove it from the heat and mix in the sesame seeds.
  6. Place the cooked chicken in a large bowl and pour the honey sesame sauce over it. Mix gently. Serve immediately with rice and your choice of veggie. Top with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onion. Enjoy!

Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 15 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 lbs cod, (cut into chunks or strips)
  • 1/2 cup flour
  • 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1/2 tsp cumin
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1 egg
  • Oil spray (or a little olive oil for cooking)
  • 1 ripe mango, (diced)
  • 1/4 red onion, (finely diced)
  • 1/2 jalapeño, (minced (optional))
  • 1/2 lime, (juiced)
  • Cilantro, (handful, chopped)
  • 1 avocado, (diced)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • 1/2 cup greek yogurt
  • 1/4 cup mayo
  • 1/2 lime, (juiced)
  • 2 tsp honey
  • 1/2 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Shredded red cabbage
  • Choice of rice

Steps

  1. Start by prepping your cod by patting it very dry with paper towels, which is key for getting a crispy texture.
  2. Set up a breading station with three bowls. In the first bowl, combine the flour with half of the chili powder, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. In the second bowl, beat the egg. In the third bowl, mix the panko breadcrumbs with the remaining spices.
  3. Dredge each piece of cod in the flour, then dip it into the egg, and finally press it into the seasoned panko until fully coated.
  4. Cook the cod using your preferred method. You can pan fry it in a thin layer of oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
  5. You can also air fry it at 400 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes, spraying with oil and flipping halfway through, or bake it at 425 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes on a rack, making sure to spray well with oil. Once cooked, let the cod rest for a couple of minutes and finish with a light sprinkle of salt.
  6. While the fish cooks, make the mango salsa by combining diced mango, finely diced red onion, minced jalapeño if using, lime juice, chopped cilantro, diced avocado, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together and let it sit so the flavors can meld.
  7. For the sauce, whisk together Greek yogurt, mayo, lime juice, honey, chili powder, garlic powder, and salt until smooth. Taste and adjust the lime juice and salt as needed.
  8. To build your bowls, start with a base of cooked rice such as white, brown, or cilantro lime rice, and add shredded red cabbage. Top with the crispy cod, a generous scoop of mango salsa, and a drizzle of the creamy sauce.

Skip the rolling and still get all the flavors you love. This Crockpot Chicken Enchiladas recipe is packed with tender shredded chicken, enchilada sauce, black beans, green chiles, and melty cheese for an easy slow cooker dinner that's perfect for busy weeknights and delicious as leftovers.

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 180 minTotal 195 min

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts
  • 16 oz red enchilada sauce

  • 1/2 small onion, (diced)
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 8 small corn tortillas (sliced into strips)
  • 2 cups shredded Mexican blend cheese

  • Sour cream

Steps

  2. Add the chicken to the crockpot making sure to cover it with the sauce.
  3. Cook on high for about 2 1/2 hours or until the chicken is fully cooked.
  4. Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the crockpot and shred it. Place the chicken back in the crockpot and give it a good stir.
  5. To the top of the enchilada mixture add the sliced tortilla strips and shredded cheese.

  • 2 cloves garlic, (minced)
  • 1 cup corn, (canned & drained or frozen)

  • 1 can Rotel, (diced tomatoes with green chiles)
  • 1 can cream of mushroom soup
  • 1 can cream of chicken soup
  • ½ cup beef broth

  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • ½ tsp salt
  • ½ tsp pepper
  • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
  • ½ cup sour cream
  • Extra sour cream
  • Extra shredded cheese
  • Sliced green onions

Steps

  1. Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, stirring in the diced onion. Cook until the beef is fully cooked and the onion is soft. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds, just until fragrant.
  2. Transfer the beef mixture to the crockpot. Add the diced potatoes, corn, black beans, Rotel, cream of mushroom, cream of chicken, beef broth, tomato paste, and all seasonings. Stir well until everything is evenly combined.
  3. Cover and cook on high for 3 to 4 hours, stirring once halfway through, until the potatoes are fork tender. Start checking around the 3 hour mark since crockpots can vary.

Crockpot French Onion Dip Sandwiches

Crockpot French Onion Dip Sandwiches Tender, fall-apart chuck roast slow cooked with buttery onions and savory au jus, then piled onto toasted buns with melty provolone.

Serves 6

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • For the Roast
  • 2 lb chuck roast
  • Garlic powder, to taste
  • Onion powder, to taste
  • Black pepper, to taste
  • Buttery garlic & herb seasoning, to taste
  • 4 tbsp butter
  • 1 packet au jus gravy mix
  • 1 packet beefy onion soup mix
  • 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 2 cups chicken broth
  • For the Onions
  • 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • For Serving
  • Hoagie or sub rolls
  • Provolone cheese

Steps

  1. Evenly season the chuck roast on all sides with garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and buttery garlic & herb seasoning.
  2. Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chuck roast and sear for 2–3 minutes per side, or until nicely browned. Transfer the roast to your slow cooker.
  3. Sprinkle the au jus gravy mix and beefy onion soup mix over the roast. Add the Worcestershire sauce and chicken broth.
  4. In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add the sliced onion and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized.
  5. Spoon the onions directly over the roast. Cover and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours, or until the beef is fall-apart tender.
  6. Remove the roast from the slow cooker and shred it with two forks. Return the beef to the slow cooker and toss it with some of the onions and juices.
  7. Pile the shredded beef and onions onto your buns and top with provolone cheese. For extra melty cheese, pop the assembled sandwiches under the broiler for a minute or two.
  8. Ladle some of the cooking liquid from the slow cooker into small bowls and serve alongside the sandwiches for dipping.

Crockpot White Chicken Enchiladas 🤩

crockpot white chicken enchiladas 🤩 What you’ll need: 2 ½ lbs thinly sliced chicken breast 2 cans of diced green chilis, hot or mild 8-10 small tortillas cut into strips 2 cups Cheddar Jack cheese ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese For the white enchilada sauce: 3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp all-purpose f

Serves 8Prep 10 minCook 210 minTotal 220 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 ½ lbs thinly sliced chicken breast
  • 2 cans of diced green chilis, (hot or mild)
  • 8-10 small tortillas cut into strips
  • 2 cups cheddar Jack cheese
  • ½ cup shredded mozzarella cheese
  • 3 tbsp butter
  • 3 tbsp all-purpose flour
  • 1 cup chicken broth
  • 1 cup whole milk
  • ½ cup sour cream
  • 1 cup salsa verde
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp cumin
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp black pepper
  • Sliced jalapenos
  • Chopped cilantro
  • Extra salsa verde
  • Sour cream
  • Hot sauce

Steps

  1. In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter.
  2. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute, whisking constantly, until smooth and lightly bubbly.
  3. Gradually whisk in the chicken broth and milk until smooth and thickened, adjusting the heat to maintain a gentle simmer.
  4. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the sour cream, salsa verde, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
  5. Remove from the heat once the sauce is silky, smooth, and thoroughly combined. When properly thickened, it should lightly coat the back of a spoon without immediately dripping off.
  6. Place the chicken in the crockpot in an even layer, then sprinkle the diced green chiles over the top.
  7. Pour the sauce over the chicken, making sure it's evenly coated. Cook on low for 3½ - 4 hours, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender. Check it at 3 ½ hours as everyone's crockpot is different.
  8. Shred the chicken directly in the crockpot, then stir in the tortilla strips.
  9. Top with the Cheddar Jack and cheddar cheeses, cover, and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted.
  10. Turn off the crockpot and let it sit for about 10 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken slightly. Top with your favorite toppings, such as hot sauce, sour cream, freshly sliced jalapeños, or cilantro. Enjoy!

Dairy Free Pumpkin Muffins

These pumpkin muffins are not only easy to make at home, but taste even better than store bought!

Serves 14Prep 15 minCook 25 minTotal 45 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 ½ cups all-purpose flour (190 grams)
  • 1 ½ cups white sugar (300 grams)
  • 2 teaspoons cinnamon
  • 1 teaspoon ginger
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon cloves
  • ½ teaspoon salt
  • 15 ounce canned pumpkin puree or butternut squash puree (425 grams)
  • 2 eggs
  • ¼ cup oil (60 milliliters)
  • ¼ cup water (60 milliliters)
  • 1 ¼ cup all-purpose flour (156 grams)
  • 1/2 cup cup brown sugar, packed (100 grams)
  • 1/3 cup cup white sugar (65 grams)
  • 1 teaspoon cinnamon
  • 1/4 cup oil
  • 1 tablespoon water, optional
  • 3/4 cups powdered sugar (180 grams)
  • 2 tablespoons water
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 350°F or 175°C and set an oven rack in the middle position.
  2. Whisk together flour, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, baking powder, cloves, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
  3. Add pumpkin pie filling, eggs, oil, and water. Make sure not to leave any of the dry mixture at the bottom. Smooth out any lumps you may find.
  4. Use a ladle to pour batter into paper-lined muffin pan cups until about ⅔ full.
  5. In a separate medium sized mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Add oil and use a fork to mix until combined into a streusel. If it's too dry, add the water.
  6. Sprinkle the streusel on top of each cup of batter.
  7. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centers comes out clean.
  8. Remove muffins and let cool for 10 minutes before moving to cooling rack.
  9. In a small mixing bowl, combine powdered sugar, water, and vanilla until smooth.
  10. Drizzle icing over each muffin.

  • 2 tsp rice vinegar
  • 2 tsp granulated sugar
  • Cucumber Salad
  • 1/2 English cucumber, thinly sliced
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp hoisin sauce
  • Chili crunch, to taste
  • Sesame seeds, to taste

Steps

  1. Prepare the rice according to your rice cooker's instructions. Once cooked, stir in the salt, rice vinegar, and sugar, if using.
  2. While the rice cooks, whisk together the brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, crushed red pepper flakes, ground ginger, and minced garlic in a small bowl. Set aside.
  3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until it begins to brown. Add the sliced green onions and continue cooking until the beef is fully cooked. Drain any excess grease if needed.
  4. Pour the prepared sauce over the ground beef and stir until everything is well coated. Simmer for 2–3 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly.
  5. In a medium bowl, combine the sliced cucumber, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, chili crunch, and sesame seeds. Toss until evenly coated.
  6. In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sriracha, rice vinegar, and sugar until smooth.
  7. Assemble the bowls by adding the seasoned rice, topping with the Asian beef and cucumber salad, then drizzle generously with the spicy mayo. Garnish with extra green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
