Easy Chicken Parm

This is for people who love chicken Parm… but hate making chicken Parm 🍝🤝 Crispy, cheesy, easy, and honestly even more flavorful than traditional chicken Parm in my opinion.

Serves 10

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • Chicken:
  • 2 pounds 92/8 ground chicken
  • 2 eggs
  • 1/3 cup Italian seasoned breadcrumbs
  • 1/4 cup milk
  • 1/3 cup grated Parmesan
  • Black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, adobo all-purpose seasoning (or salt), and chopped fresh basil, all to taste
  • Breadcrumb Coating:
  • 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
  • 1 cup grated Parmesan
  • 1/4 cup Italian seasoned breadcrumbs
  • Onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, and adobo all-purpose seasoning (or salt), to taste
  • For Topping:
  • Marinara sauce of choice
  • Shredded mozzarella cheese
  • Olive oil

Steps

  1. In a large bowl, combine all of the chicken ingredients until well mixed. Place the mixture in the fridge for a few minutes to firm up while you prepare the breadcrumb coating.
  2. In a separate bowl, mix together all breadcrumb coating ingredients.
  3. Take small handfuls of the chicken mixture and gently form them into cutlet shapes. Press each cutlet into the breadcrumb mixture on both sides, firm enough for the coating to stick but without flattening the shape too much.
  4. Place the cutlets onto a parchment-lined baking sheet that has been lightly sprayed with oil. Drizzle the tops lightly with olive oil.
  5. Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes, flip, then bake another 15 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. Every oven is different, so keep an eye on the color and lower the temperature slightly if needed.
  6. Top each cutlet with marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese, then return to the oven until the cheese is melted and lightly browned.
  7. Serve however you’d like — with pasta, salad, veggies, or on its own. Easy, crispy, mess-free chicken Parm.

Easy pizza dough

Light and fluffy with the perfect crunchy bottom, this dough makes for the ultimate home made pizza. With a 60 minute rise, it's also quick to pull together, making it a great weeknight meal. I top mine with pizza sauce from Woolies, mozzarella, and whatever I have in the fridge. So easy!

Serves 4Prep 10 minCook 20 minTotal 1 hr 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 300ml warm water
  • 1 squeeze of honey
  • 2 tsp instant dried yeast
  • 3 cup bread flour
  • olive oil, to stick and grease

Steps

  1. Stir together warm water, yeast and honey. Once combined, sit for 5-10 minutes. It should be a little frothy.
  2. Add your flour to a bowl. Make a well, then add your water/yeast mixture. Stir with a wooden spoon to combine.
  3. Roll your dough out on a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
  4. Use your hands to lightly coat a bowl with olive oil, add your dough, then roll your dough around to coat it in oil. Rest for 60 minutes - it should double in size.
  5. Preheat your oven to 200C fan-forced
  6. Knead your dough again for 1-2 minutes. Do this on a clean surface (no flour). Your dough should have oil on it, so it shouldn't stick. If it is sticking, drizzle some olive oil on your bench.
  7. Divide your dough into two sections - roll out each half into pizza sized shapes (around 30cm in diameter, and around 1/2 cm thick). Add to a pizza tray (I use a round baking tray with holes in it, from Kmart).
  8. Cover your pizza with your base sauce (I use Leggo's Pizza Sauce Squeezy Tomato Paste), then top with mozzarella and your favourite toppings.
  9. Bake at 200C fan-forced for 15 minutes or until cheese and edges are starting to brown.
  10. Allow to cool slightly, then cut into triangles or strips for your little ones. Enjoy!

Source: Ashleigh Cooks - Simple, healthy family recipes for baby, toddler, mum and dad.

Everyday Banana Muffins

Perfect banana muffins with no refined sugar. Healthy and easy breakfast for you and the kids!

Serves 12Prep 8 minCook 12 minTotal 20 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 3 Ripe Bananas
  • ¼ cup Coconut Oil (melted)
  • ¼ cup Honey or Agave Syrup
  • 1 Large Egg (room temp is best)
  • 1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
  • 1 ½ cups All Purpose Flour (or gluten free flour blend)
  • 1 teaspoon Baking Soda
  • ½ teaspoon Baking Powder
  • ½ teaspoon Salt

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly oil a 12 muffin tin with non stick cooking spray or line with paper liners. Set aside.
  2. In a large bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until only small lumps remain.
  3. To the bananas, add the oil, honey (or agave), egg and vanilla. Mix well.
  4. Add dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and gently combine. Careful not to over mix. (Over mixing will give you tough muffins.)
  5. Fill muffin tins about 2/3 full, which should perfectly use all the batter. Bake for 12-15 minutes until the tops bounce back when touched.

Favorite Blueberry Mini Muffins

Serves 12Prep 10 minCook 12 minTotal 22 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup all-purpose flour
  • ⅓ cup sugar
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon baking soda
  • ¼ teaspoon salt
  • ¾ cup plain Greek whole milk yogurt
  • ¼ cup unsalted butter ((melted and slightly cooled))
  • 2 eggs ((lightly beaten))
  • 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
  • ½ cup blueberries ((fresh or frozen; frozen wild blueberries are a perfect size for this recipe))
  • 1 tablespoon fresh lemon zest and fresh lemon juice, OR 1 teaspoon cinnamon ((optional))

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 24-cup mini muffin pan with nonstick spray.
  2. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
  3. In another bowl, stir together the yogurt, eggs, butter, and vanilla.
  4. Gently stir the yogurt mixture into the flour mixture.
  5. Divide batter among the prepared muffin tin, filling about to the edge. (You'll use about 1 1/2 tablespoons in each mini muffin cup.) Add a few blueberries to the top of each and press down slightly.
  6. Bake for 12-14 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown and a cake tester inserted into the center comes out cleanly.
  7. (To make these as full-size muffins, use a 12-cup muffin pan and bake for 16-18 minutes.)
  8. Remove from oven, and let cool in the pan for 2 minutes. Run a paring knife around the edges to loosen, if needed, then carefully transfer muffins to a wire rack to cool fully.

  1. Preheat the oven to 375℉.

  • 1/2 Cup Greek Yogurt
  • 1 Lime (juiced -- this is approximately 2 tablespoons)

  • 1 pinch Cayenne Pepper (optional but highly recommended!)

Steps

  1. To make these bowls, start by preparing the rice. Cook the rice according to the package instructions and set it aside. If you want to save time here, you can also use frozen jasmine rice and heat it to temperature.

  3. Next, prepare the fish. Pat the fish filets dry and place them on a cutting board.
  4. Season both sides of the fish generously with the taco seasoning.
  5. Then, heat a cast iron skillet, on the stove, over medium heat, and add in the butter.
  6. Once the butter has melted, add the fish to the pan and allow it to cook for 4-5 minutes, until it's browned and flaky. Then, flip it to the other side and allow it cook for another 4-5 minutes.
  7. While fish is cooking, prepare the mango salsa. Dice the mango, jalapeño, red onion, and cilantro, and add it to a bowl alongside the lime juice and salt. Mix to combine.
  8. Set the mango salsa aside and prepare the chipotle lime sauce. Add all of the sauce ingredients (the yogurt, lime, chili powder, and cayenne pepper, if using) to a bowl and stir until fully combined.
  9. Finally, assemble the bowls. Add a spoonful of rice to the bottom of the bowl, then add the fish on top.
  10. Add a scoop of the mango salsa on top, followed by the sliced purple cabbage and a drizzle of the chipotle lime sauce.
  11. Garnish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice, then serve and enjoy!

Ingredients

  • Dry:

  • Salt- 1/2 tsp
  • Wet:

  • Melted Unsalted Butter- 4 tbsp
  • Vanilla- 1 tbsp
  • * Eggs- 1
  • To Cook:
  • Oil
  • Butter

Steps

  1. Make a dry batter with flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
  2. Whisk together and set aside.
  3. Make a wet batter with buttermilk, milk, melted unsalted butter, vanilla, and egg.
  4. Slowly pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture while folding and not over whisking. (Lumps are good)
  5. Let the batter rest for 5-10 minutes.
  6. Preheat a skillet to medium low. Lowest form of medium you can get)
  7. To the pan add in a little oil and butter. This helps to achieve the crispy edges.
  8. Allow the pancake to cook until small air bubbles begin to form. This is the cue to flip the pancake.
  9. Once it’s flipped, do not pat the pancake down. This helps with keeping the pancake fluffy. Patting creates a thin and dense outcome.
  10. Cook until the bottom is also crispy then remove from the pan and immediately add butter.

  • -10 English muffins

  • 1/3 cup hot honey
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • salt & pepper

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350 F. whisk together eggs & milk, scallions, 1/2 teaspoon salt & some black pepper.
  2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, and grease. Pour the eggs into the baking sheetand bake for about 15 minutes until eggs are fully set. Use the back of a glass to cut into circles (or slice into rectangles for less waste. I use the leftover eggs for burritos or to give the baby!)

  4. In a large bowl, add ground chicken, hot honey, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt & a pinch or two of black pepper. Mix together until everything is combined, taking care not to over mix.
  5. In a large skillet on medium heat, coat the bottom of the pan with olive oil. form the chicken mixture into 1/2-inch thick patties that are the width of your English muffin (they will shrink down). Add to the pan and cook for 5 minutes on each side.
  6. Assemble your sandwiches by adding a slice of cheese onto one half of an English muffin and topping with the sausage, egg, and remaining half of English muffin.
  7. to store your sandwiches, wrap in parchment paper and place in freezer-safe bags.
  8. to reheat: thaw in the fridge the night before, unwrap, and then bake at 400 F for 10 minutes. from frozen, it's closer to 25 minutes

Garlic Parmesan Chicken Meatloaf

This Garlic Parmesan Chicken Meatloaf is a juicy, cheesy twist on classic meatloaf made with ground chicken, Parmesan, and Italian seasoning. Topped with a sweet-tangy glaze and melted mozzarella, it’s a comforting, flavor-packed dinner.

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 50 minTotal 65 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs ground chicken, (can also use beef)
  • 1 small yellow onion, (finely diced)
  • 4 cloves of garlic, (minced)
  • 1 cup shredded parmesan cheese
  • 1 cup of Italian breadcrumbs
  • ½ cup milk
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 tbsp Italian seasoning
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp pepper
  • 1 tbsp worcestershire sauce
  • 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
  • ½ cup ketchup
  • 2 tbsp brown sugar
  • 1 tbsp dijon mustard
  • 1 tsp worcestershire sauce
  • Freshly grated Parmesan cheese
  • Fresh chives, (chopped)

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 375℉.
  2. In a large bowl, add the ground chicken, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, eggs, milk, Worcestershire sauce, and all seasonings. Mix until everything is well combined.
  3. Transfer the meat mixture to a greased loaf pan and gently press it into an even layer. Set aside.
  4. In a small bowl, combine all of the glaze ingredients and mix well. Spoon a little over half of the glaze evenly over the top of the meatloaf, reserving the remaining glaze for later.
  5. Bake for 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and spread the remaining glaze over the top, then sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Return to the oven and bake for another 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the meatloaf is fully cooked. Feel free to broil at the end to get the cheese golden brown!
  6. Remove from the oven and let rest for about 10 minutes.
  7. Garnish with freshly grated Parmesan cheese and chives. Serve with mashed potatoes and your favorite veggie. Enjoy!

Ingredients

  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 1 tablespoon minced garlic
  • 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
  • 1 cup orzo
  • 2 1/2 cups chicken stock
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1/2 cup mozzarella, grated
  • 1/4 cup Parmesan, grated
  • Seasonings:
  • Kinders Cowboy Butter Seasoning
  • Kinders Lemon Butter Garlic Seasoning
  • Topping:
  • 1/2 cup panko
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • Parsley
  • Garlic salt

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 425°F.
  2. Add olive oil to a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook until softened.
  3. Add chicken and season with Kinders Cowboy Butter and Kinders Lemon Butter Garlic. Cook until chicken is cooked through.
  4. Add Worcestershire sauce and minced garlic. Cook for 2 minutes.
  5. Add orzo and chicken stock. Stir and bring to a simmer. Cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
  6. Cover and cook for another 5 minutes.
  7. Stir in heavy cream, mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the orzo is creamy and tender.
  8. In a small bowl, mix panko, olive oil, parsley and garlic salt.
  9. Sprinkle the panko mixture evenly over the top of the orzo.
  10. Bake uncovered at 425°F for 5 minutes, then broil for 2 minutes until the panko is golden and crispy.

  • 3- 4 green onions, sliced (for garnish)
  • Toasted sesame seeds (optional)

Steps

  1. Prep & Sear: Pat beef dry; season with salt/pepper and toss with cornstarch. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over high heat. Sear beef in batches until deeply browned (2-3 mins/side). Remove and set aside.
  2. Build the Glaze: Reduce heat to medium. Add remaining 1 tbsp oil. Sauté garlic and ginger 1 min until fragrant. Whisk in soy sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, broth, and honey. Simmer 3-5 mins until slightly thickened.
  3. Combine & Bake: Return beef to pan, tossing to coat in glaze. Transfer to preheated 375°F (190°C) oven. Bake uncovered 25-30 mins, stirring halfway, until beef is fork-tender and glaze is sticky/caramelized.
  4. Finish & Serve: Remove from oven. Let rest 5 mins. Garnish generously with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice, cauliflower rice, or lo mein noodles. Spoon extra glaze over top!

Glazed Donut Bread

Glazed Donut Bread is a soft, tender loaf topped with a shiny vanilla glaze that drips down the sides. Inspired by my Cinnamon Sugar Donut Bread, this easy breakfast bread is perfect for mornings, brunch, or a sweet snack!

Serves 12Prep 15 minCook 60 minTotal 75 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 ½ cups (300 g) granulated sugar
  • 2 teaspoons baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon kosher salt
  • ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg
  • 1 ¼ cups (306 g) whole milk
  • 1 large egg, (room temperature)
  • 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, (melted)
  • 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
  • 2 cups (250 g) confectioners’ sugar
  • 4 to 5 tablespoons milk, (or heavy cream for richer glaze)
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 pinch kosher salt, (optional (enhances flavor))

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray an 8 ½ x 4 ½-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray.
  2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, salt, and ground nutmeg.
  3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla until well combined.
  4. Pour the milk mixture into the flour mixture and stir gently until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; the batter should be a bit runny.
  5. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan, spreading it evenly.
  6. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few crumbs and the top is golden brown.
  7. Once baked, remove the bread from the oven and let it cool in the pan for about 10 minutes. Then, carefully remove the bread from the pan and place it on a wire rack set over parchment paper (to catch drips).
  8. In a medium bowl, whisk together confectioners' sugar, 4 tablespoons milk, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt until smooth. If too thick, add milk ½ tablespoon at a time until pourable. (It should be thick but drizzle easily.)
  9. While the bread is still slightly warm, pour or spoon the glaze generously over the top, letting it drip down the sides. For full donut-style coverage, you can dip the top directly into the glaze or brush on extra layers.
  10. Let the glaze set for 20 to 30 minutes before slicing and serving.

Grain Free Chocolate Chip Cassava Cookie Bars

These cookie bars have a rich, buttery flavor, and they come together in one bowl and one pan. AND they’re naturally gluten-free and grain-free. Yesssssssssss (please)!! The bars are made with cassava flour, which lends the cookies a fluffy texture with a light but rich crumb. They’re irresistible when warm, and they freeze beautifully. The cookie bars are naturally sweetened with coconut sugar (a

Serves 12Prep 20 minCook 25 minTotal 45 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • Cooking spray, for pan
  • 1/2 cup (1 stick) butter, softened
  • 3/4 cup (115 g) packed coconut sugar (sometimes labeled coconut palm sugar)
  • 2 large eggs
  • 2 tablespoons honey or maple syrup
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 cup (130 g) cassava flour (I prefer Bob's Red Mill brand)
  • 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt
  • 1 1/4 cups chocolate chips, divided
  • 1/4 cup chopped pecans (optional)

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (175 degrees Celsius). Spray an 8x8-inch pan with cooking spray, then line it crosswise with parchment paper (this will make it easy to pull the cookie bars out later).
  2. In the bowl of a stand mixer with the paddle attachment, combine the softened butter and coconut sugar. Mix on high until lightened in color and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add the eggs, honey and vanilla, and mix on high until incorporated, stopping and scraping the sides as needed, about 1 to 2 minutes. Add the cassava flour, baking powder and salt, and mix on low until incorporated (the batter will be thick). Scrape the sides, and add 1 cup of the chocolate chips and the pecans. Mix on low until just combined.
  3. Spread the batter in an even layer in the prepared pan (it will be quite thick so will take a bit of work to get it into the corners—a small offset spatula works great). Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips. Bake until golden brown on top, about 24 to 26 minutes. Place the pan on a wire rack and let cool. Remove the cookie by pulling on the parchment handles. Cut it into bars using a sharp knife, cleaning the knife between slices (you can cut into 9 large bars or smaller bite-sized squares). If you’re anything like me, you’re going to want to serve these with cold milk or ice cream (yesssss)!!

Ground Pork Tacos with Pineapple Salsa

who’s hungry?!!

Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 15 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 lbs ground pork
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1/2 tsp cumin
  • 1/2 tsp oregano
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 3 cloves garlic, (minced)
  • 1 tsp soy sauce
  • 1/4 cup pineapple juice
  • 1/2 lime, (juiced)
  • Flour or corn small tortillas
  • 1 cup pineapple
  • 1/4 red onion
  • 2 jalapeño
  • 1/3 cup cilantro
  • 1/2 lime, (juiced)
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1/2 cup sour cream
  • 1 tbsp mayo
  • 1 lime, (juiced)
  • 2 tsp honey
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • Pinch of salt

Steps

  1. Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add the ground pork and break it apart with a spatula as it cooks. When it's about halfway cooked, stir in the minced garlic, chili powder, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until well incorporated.
  2. Stir in the soy sauce, pineapple juice, and the juice of ½ lime. Let everything simmer for about 5 more minutes, until the liquid slightly reduces and the pork is fully cooked.
  3. While the pork cooks, make the pineapple salsa by combining the finely chopped pineapple, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir well and set aside so the flavors can meld together.
  4. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the sour cream, mayo, lime juice, honey, chili powder, and a pinch of salt until smooth and creamy.
  5. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame until soft and lightly charred.
  6. Assemble the tacos by filling each tortilla with the pork, topping with the fresh pineapple salsa, and finishing with a generous drizzle of the chili lime crema. Serve immediately with extra lime wedges if desired.

Source: Cailee Eats · Original post

Ham Cheddar + Chive Protein Biscuits

Ham Cheddar + Chive Protein Biscuits!

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 30 minTotal 45 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup cottage cheese
  • 1/4 cup milk, plus more for brushing tops
  • 1 tbsp honey
  • 2 tbsp melted salted butter
  • 7 oz deli ham, diced in to small pieces
  • 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese
  • 1/3 cup diced green onion OR chives (or a mix)
  • 2 cups bread flour
  • 1 TBSP baking powder
  • 1/4 tsp baking soda
  • 1 tsp sea salt
  • 1/2 tsp black pepper

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 425 and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. Blend cottage cheese and milk until creamy. In a large bowl, mix with honey and melted butter, then fold in ham, cheese, and green onion.
  3. In a separate large bowl, mix together all of your dry ingredients. Add to your wet ingredients and mix until just combined- dough will be crumbly and looks slightly dry. That’s OK!
  4. Turn your dough out onto a clean floured work surface. Use floured hands to combine the dough to make it less crumbly and into more of a smooth dough.
  5. Roll dough out as much as you can into a rectangle (ish) about 3/4 inch thick. Don’t worry about it being too perfect! Fold one end of the rectangle into the center, and then the other end of the rectangle over it, like a letter.
  6. Flatten dough again into a more narrow rectangle that is again about 3/4 inch thick. Repeat the process of folding one end into the center and then the other end over it. This is what creates the layers in the biscuits!
  7. Roll a little once again just to pack layers together more tightly. Cut dough into 6-9 biscuits and place on baking sheet almost touching each other.
  8. Brush the tops with milk and then bake for 15-30 minutes (depending on size of your biscuits- smaller ones will cook faster), until tops are slightly brown in centers are set. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before enjoying. Optional: brush tops w/ butter + honey!

hash brown egg nests

meal prep breakfast on repeat!!!

Serves 6Prep 10 minCook 30 minTotal 40 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 4 cups shredded hash browns, (thawed)
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp black pepper
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese, (divided)
  • 12 large eggs
  • Cooking spray
  • 2 tbsp fresh chives, (finely chopped)
  • Hot sauce or ketchup (for serving)

Steps

  1. Preheat your oven to 425°F. Generously grease a 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray.
  2. In a large bowl, combine the thawed hash browns, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and 1/2 cup of the shredded cheddar cheese. Mix until everything is evenly combined.
  3. Divide the hash brown mixture evenly between the muffin cups. Using your fingers, press the mixture firmly into each cup, making the sides slightly thicker and the bottom thinner. Use the bottom of a 1/4 or 1/3 cup measuring cup to gently press down and create a nest in the center of each.
  4. Lightly spray the tops of the hash browns with cooking spray to help them crisp. Bake for 20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and starting to crisp.
  5. Remove the pan from the oven. Carefully crack one egg into each hash brown nest, then sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup of cheddar cheese evenly over the tops.
  6. Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 10-12 minutes, depending on how you like your eggs. For a runnier yolk, check them around the 10-minute mark. For a firmer yolk, bake a little longer.
  7. Let the egg cups cool in the muffin pan for about 10 minutes before carefully loosening the edges with a small knife and removing them.
  8. Top with a sprinkle of salt, black pepper, and freshly chopped chives. Serve warm with your favorite hot sauce or ketchup.

Source: Cailee Eats · Original post

Hawaiian Roll Recipe

Ditch the crap and enjoy fresh homemade Hawaiian Rolls with just 7 simple ingredients!

Serves 12

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • Hawaiian Roll Recipe
  • 1 cup warm water
  • 2 1/4 teaspoons yeast (1 standard packet)
  • 1/3 cup honey
  • 1/4 cup avocado oil
  • 1 teaspoon salt
  • 3 cups all-purpose flour
  • 2 Tablespoons melted butter (for on top of rolls)

Steps

  1. In a small bowl, combine the warm water, yeast, and honey. Stir lightly and let it sit for 5-10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
  2. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and oil.
  3. Add the frothy yeast mixture to the bowl and mix well.
  4. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 2-3 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
  5. Shape into 12 ball shapes and place them in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish or on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
  6. Cover the shaped rolls with a clean kitchen towel and let them rise for 30-45 minutes, or until puffy.
  7. Gently brush the rolls with the melted butter before placing them in the oven Preheat your oven to 375°F Bake the rolls for 18-20 minutes, or until golden brown on top.
  8. While the rolls are still warm, brush them with the remaining melted butter.
  9. Once cooled slice through the entire section of 12 rolls and layer ham, mayo, and cheese.
  10. Place the top half of the rolls back on top and put back in the oven for 8-10 minutes!

Healthy Baked Apple Fritters "Cookies" (gluten free + dairy free)

These Healthy Baked Apple Fritters are soft, cozy, and naturally sweetened with apples and applesauce. Made with oats, oat flour, and warm cinnamon, they’re a gluten-free and dairy-free snack or breakfast your toddler (and you!) will love. Easy to make in one bowl, freezer-friendly, and perfectly sweet without any added sugar.

Serves 8Prep 10 minCook 18 minTotal 28 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup finely chopped (or shredded) apple (Honeycrisp, Fuji, or Gala are my faves)
  • ½ cup rolled oats
  • ½ cup oat flour
  • ½ tsp baking powder
  • ½ tsp cinnamon (or measure with your heart!)
  • ¼ cup unsweetened applesauce
  • 1 egg (or flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp warm water, let thicken))
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1 tbsp oil (melted coconut or avocado oil or butter)

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a bowl, whisk together the egg (or flax egg), applesauce, vanilla, and oil until smooth.
  3. Stir in oats, oat flour, baking powder, and cinnamon until combined, then fold in the chopped apple.
  4. Scoop 2-3 tablespoons of batter per fritter onto the baking sheet and flatten slightly.
  5. Brush or spray the tops with a little oil and bake for 16-20 minutes, until golden and set.
  6. Let cool slightly before serving. Drizzle with glaze drizzle if desired or pair with yogurt to dip!

Healthy Gluten-Free Greek Yogurt Pancakes

if you're looking for thick, fluffy, and flavorful pancakes that are secretly packed with protein and naturally gluten-free, these healthy greek yogurt vanilla pancakes are your new breakfast best friend.

Serves 3Prep 15 minCook 4 minTotal 19 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad

Ingredients

  • 1 cup gluten-free 1:1 baking flour (make sure it includes xanthan gum or add 1/4 tsp if not)
  • 1 1/2 tsp baking powder
  • 1/4 tsp baking soda
  • 1/4 tsp salt 2 large eggs 1 cup plain greek yogurt (dairy-free or regular)
  • 1/4 cup milk (any kind)
  • 2 tbsp melted butter or coconut oil (or neutral oil)
  • 1/2 tbsp vanilla paste
  • 1 to 2 tbsp maple syrup (optional, for sweetness)
  • 1/4 cup coconut sugar
  • 1/2 tbsp cinnamon
  • 1 tbsp melted butter

Steps

  1. in a medium bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
  2. in another bowl, mix the greek yogurt, eggs, milk, melted butter, vanilla, and maple syrup until smooth.
  3. pour the dry ingredients into the wet and gently stir until just combined. don't overmix—slightly lumpy batter is okay. let the batter rest for 5–10 minutes to thicken.
  4. heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-low heat and grease lightly.
  5. scoop the batter (about 1/4 cup per pancake) and spread gently if needed. sprinkle cinnamon sugar mixture if desired. cover the pan with a lid and cook for 2–3 max minutes per side, flipping once bubbles form and the edges look set. covering traps steam, which helps the pancakes rise higher and stay super moist and fluffy.
  6. serve warm with fruit, yogurt, nut butter, or maple syrup.

  • 1 tbsp cornstarch

  • 1 tsp ginger, minced

  • 3 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 tsp ginger, minced

  • Salt to taste
  • 1 tbsp oil
  • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
  • 2 tbsp green onions chopped

Steps

  1. In a medium-size bowl combine all the ingredients under the “to marinate chicken” section and mix it thoroughly and marinate the chicken for at least 10 minutes.

  7. Serve the orange chicken along with rice and veggies.

High Protein Biscuits

Don’t let homemade biscuits intimidate you - these easy high-protein biscuits are incredibly forgiving and perfect for beginners. The quick, no-knead dough bakes up soft and flaky every time, all thanks to the secret ingredient: cottage cheese.

Serves 8Prep 10 minCook 15 minTotal 25 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup full-fat cottage cheese (small curd)
  • 1 tbsp maple syrup
  • 2 cups all purpose flour
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • ½ tsp salt
  • ¼ cup cold butter (grated)

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
  2. Add the cottage cheese and maple syrup to a high-powered blender and blend until completely smooth.
  3. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
  4. Cut in the butter. Add the cold grated butter and use a fork to mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  5. Add the blended cottage cheese mixture and stir until a dough forms. At first, the dough may look a little rough and shaggy, but this is normal. As you gently fold and pat it, it will come together into a soft, workable dough.
  6. Place the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat it down into a 1-inch thick round. Fold the dough over itself, then pat it back down into a 1-inch-thick round. Repeat this folding and patting process about 10 times. This helps create flaky, layered biscuits. (Note: It's important to gently pat and not knead or roll.) After the final fold, pat the dough into a 1-inch-thick round and cut out biscuits using either a biscuit cutter or a small circular cookie cutter.
  7. After cutting out the biscuits, gently gather the dough scraps and press them together (do not knead). Pat the dough back into a 1-inch-thick round and cut out additional biscuits. I was able to get about 8 biscuits out of this dough.
  8. Place biscuits on a baking sheet and bake 12–15 minutes, until golden. If desired, immediately brush with melted butter as soon as they come out of the oven.

Source: Feeding Tiny Bellies

Homemade High Protein Bagels

Learn how to make high protein bagels at home with just 5 ingredients! These bagels have a whopping 10 grams of protein per bagel and are made with greek yogurt and baking powder instead of yeast! So quick and easy to meal prep for breakfast throughout the week!

Prep 15 minCook 20 minTotal 45 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2¼ cups all purpose flour (or bread flour)
  • 4 teaspoons baking powder
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1½ cup greek yogurt
  • 1 egg white (lightly beaten)
  • Sesame seeds or everything bagel seasoning

Steps

  1. PREP: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350ºF. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.
  2. MIX: In a bowl, whisk the dry ingredients until mixed. Then add the greek yogurt and mix together until a dough forms. You might want to use your hands to make this easier!
  3. DIVIDE: Turn the dough out onto a clean surface. Divide it out into 6 equal pieces. If the dough is sticky dust with flour, I didn’t need to.
  4. ROLL: out the dough into a thick rope, about 7-8 inches in length. Join the ends and gently press. Place your hand through the hole gently roll the joining part on the counter so that the ends fuse. Place the bagels on the prepared baking sheet and let sit for 5-10 minutes if possible. This allows the bagels to puff up more.
  5. BRUSH AND SPRINKLE: On a clean plate, place one bagel, brush with the beaten egg white. Sprinkle with sesame seeds or bagel seasoning. Place the bagel on the baking sheet and repeat with the remaining bagels.
  6. BAKE: Place the pan in the oven and bake the bagels for 20-25 minutes or golden brown on top. Remove the bagels to a wire rack and let them rest for 10 minutes or until cooled so you can slice them. Toast if desired and spread with cream cheese. Store leftover bagels in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

Source: Little Spice Jar

Homemade Pizza Rolls (Copycat Totinos)

These homemade pizza rolls are the crispy little freezer-snack copycat with all the classic pizza flavors in one bite-sized little pocket. Made with wonton wrappers instead of dough, they cook up extra golden and crunchy in the air fryer while still staying gooey and cheesy on the inside.

Serves 40Prep 15 minCook 8 minTotal 23 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 cup shredded mozzarella
  • ⅓ cup finely chopped pepperoni
  • 2-3 tbsp pizza sauce
  • 2 tbsp softenend cream cheese (or swap with 2 tbsp parmesan and an extra ¼ cup of mozzarella)
  • ½ tsp garlic powder
  • ½ tsp Italian seasoning
  • 20 wonton wrappers

Steps

  1. In a medium bowl, mix together the shredded mozzarella, finely chopped pepperoni, pizza sauce, softened cream cheese, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning to form a thick filling.
  2. Lay one wonton wrapper on a clean work surface. Lightly brush water around all four outer edges. Then brush one horizontal line and one vertical line through the center of the wrapper to divide the middle into 4 equal filling sections.
  3. Add about 1 teaspoon of filling into each section.
  4. Place a second wonton wrapper on top. Press firmly around all outer edges and around each filling section with your fingers to fully seal the wrappers together.
  5. Use a pizza cutter or knife to slice along the sealed center lines, creating 4 individual pizza rolls. Pinch all cut edges again to make they are sealed tightly. Repeat with the remaining wrappers until you have about 40 pizza rolls total.
  6. Place the pizza rolls in batches in a single layer in an air fryer basket and spray generously with oil. Air fry at 375 degrees F for 6–8 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. *Optional: Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with parmesan cheese and parsley if desired.

Homemade Twix Bars

not a normal day in the kitchen unless something goes wrong 🫠 homemade “twix” bars 🍫🤭💫 What you’ll need: For the crust: 1 1/2 cups oat flour (blend rolled oats until fine) 1/4 cup melted butter 3 tbsp maple syrup 1 tsp vanilla extract 1/2 tsp salt For the date caramel: 1 cup soft Medjool dates (p

Serves 12

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • For the crust:
  • 1 1/2 cups oat flour (blend rolled oats until fine)
  • 1/4 cup melted butter
  • 3 tbsp maple syrup
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • For the date caramel:
  • 1 cup soft Medjool dates (pitted)
  • 1/4 cup natural peanut butter
  • 1 tbsp coconut oil, melted
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • Pinch of salt
  • For the topping:
  • 1/2 cup unsweetened dark chocolate chips
  • 1 tsp coconut oil
  • Flaky sea salt

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper.
  2. Mix oat flour, melted butter, maple syrup, vanilla, and salt until a dough forms.
  3. Press evenly into the pan and bake for 10-12 minutes, until edges are lightly golden.
  4. Place in the freezer to cool until you’re done prepping the caramel layer. About 15-20 minutes.
  5. To make the caramel layer, soak dates in hot water for 10 mins, then drain.
  6. Blend the dates, peanut butter, coconut oil, vanilla, and salt in a food processor until smooth. Spread the caramel evenly over the cooled shortbread, then chill in the freezer for 20-30 mins until firm.
  7. Once cooled, it’s time to make the chocolate layer. Melt chocolate and coconut oil together in the microwave in 20-30 second intervals, stirring between each. Once entirely melted, pour over the chilled caramel and spread evenly. Then add a sprinkle of flaky sea salt.
  8. Return to the freezer until set, about 15-20 minutes.
  9. Remove from the pan and slice into small bars. Enjoy immediately! Store in the fridge for up to a week or in the freezer for 1-2 months.

Ingredients

  • 5 cloves garlic (minced)
  • 1 teaspoon fresh ginger (grated or chopped)
  • 3 cups chopped baby bok choy (or spinach/cabbage)
  • 2 cups shredded carrots
  • 2 green onions (sliced (plus more for garnish))
  • 1 tablespoon sesame seeds (optional)
  • ¼ cup fresh chopped cilantro + Thai basil (for garnish)
  • ½ tsp flaky sea salt
  • ⅓ cup coconut aminos
  • 1.5 tablespoons raw honey
  • 1.5 tablespoons rice vinegar

  • ½ teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional)

Steps

  1. Cook the noodles according to package directions. Rinse under cold water and set aside.Note: cooking the noodles first ensures they’re ready to be tossed in at the end without overcooking.
  2. Prep the sauce: in a small bowl, whisk together the coconut aminos, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and if using—the red pepper flakes and arrowroot starch, until smooth.
  3. Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sear until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
  4. In the same pan, add a bit more oil if needed, then sauté garlic and ginger for 30 seconds. Add carrots, bok choy (or spinach/cabbage), and green onions. Cover with a lid and let cook 2–3 minutes until just tender, stirring several times.
  5. Return the chicken to the pan. Pour in the sauce and simmer 1–2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
  6. Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss everything together until glossy and well coated.
  7. Serve hot, topped with extra green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
  8. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. The noodles may absorb more of the sauce over time, so you can add a splash of water or coconut aminos when reheating to loosen things up.

  8. Toss until fully combined. Taste and adjust the seasonings as needed, then set the salsa aside.
  9. Next, prepare the chipotle sauce. Add all of the sauce ingredients (the greek yogurt, chipotle pepper, honey, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and kosher salt) to a blender.
  10. Blend until the sauce is smooth and creamy.
  11. Finally, assemble the bowls. Add a scoop of rice to the bottom of the bowl, followed by a scoop of the salmon, a scoop of the peach salsa, and a drizzle of the chipotle sauce.

  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder

Steps

How to make homemade cosmic brownies! 🍫✨

How to make homemade cosmic brownies!

Serves 8

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 10 tbsp (140 g) unsalted butter, melted
  • 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar
  • 1/3 cup (67 g) brown sugar, packed
  • 2 eggs 1 egg yolk, room temp
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 2/3 cup (60 g) unsweetened cocoa powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1 tbsp cornstarch
  • 3/4 cup (95 g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in)
  • Ganache Frosting:
  • 3/4 cup (130 g) semisweet chocolate chips or chopped chocolate
  • 1/4 cup (60 g) heavy cream

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C) and line/grease an 8x8-inch pan with parchment.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
  3. Add eggs and vanilla, mix until well combined.
  4. Stir in cocoa powder and salt.
  5. Then, gently fold in the flour and cornstarch until just combined (don’t over mix).
  6. Spread batter into the prepared pan.
  7. Bake for 30-40 minutes until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out mostly clean/with a few moist crumbs (not wet batter).
  8. Let the brownies cool completely.
  9. To make the ganache, melt the chocolate and heavy cream together. Microwave in 15-second intervals, stirring in between until smooth.
  10. Pour over the cooled brownies and top with rainbow candy coated chips.
  11. Chill until ganache is set (1-2 hours).

tarting off 2025 with a new high-protein breakfast biscuit flavor!!

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 35 minTotal 50 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1 medium yellow onion, diced
  • 16 ounces ground chicken
  • 2 teaspoons garlic powder
  • 2 teaspoons kosher salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper
  • 12 ounce jar sliced jalapeños in vinegar, drained and chopped (about 1 cup)
  • 8 ounces Cheddar, shredded (1 1/2 cups)
  • 6 large eggs
  • 1 1/2 cups blanched almond flour
  • 1/3 cup coconut flour
  • 2 teaspoons baking powder

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
  2. In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6 to 8 minutes.
  3. Push the onions to the side of the skillet to create a hole in the center. Add the ground chicken in the center and cook, breaking up any large chunks with a wooden spoon, until the chicken is browned and the onion is translucent, about 8 minutes.
  4. Remove from the heat, season with the garlic powder, salt, and ground black pepper and mix well. Carefully pour off any excess oil and set the mixture aside to cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
  5. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs until no streaks remain. Add the chicken mixture, 1 cup of the Cheddar, and the chopped jalapeños and mix well. Add the almond flour, coconut flour, baking powder, and spices to the bowl and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
  6. Use a lightly oiled large cookie scoop, a spoon, or clean hands to scoop about 12 balls of dough onto the sheet pan, spacing them 1 to 2 inches apart. Press down gently on the top of each ball to form a biscuit. Evenly sprinkle the tops of each with the remaining 1/2 cup of Cheddar.
  7. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the biscuits are baked through and lightly browned all over.

Ingredients

  • 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
  • 4–5 cups chicken broth

  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp cumin
  • 1/2 tsp paprika

  • For Serving

  6. Reduce the heat to low and stir in 1–2 cups of shredded Mexican-blend cheese until melted and creamy.

Lemon Parmesan One-Pan Pasta

This yummy easy one-pan pasta that's delicately delicious, full of lemony white wine flavor, tons of garlic and parmesan and topped with slices of tender juicy chicken breasts. Perfect for an easy weeknight, you'll love how quick and simple this recipe is to make.

Serves 4Prep 5 minCook 20 minTotal 25 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 chicken breasts (pounded to an even 1/4 inch thick)
  • 1-2 tablespoons cajun seasoning or all-purpose chicken seasoning (use your favorite)
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1/3 cup chicken stock
  • 4 Tablespoons butter
  • 6 cloves fresh garlic, minced
  • 3/4 cups dry white wine (sauv blanc, chard, or pinot grigio)
  • 3/4 cups chicken stock
  • 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice + zest of one lemon
  • 1 cup half and half, room temp
  • 1/2 lb angel hair pasta
  • 2/3 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly shredded
  • fresh parsley to garnish
  • red pepper flakes to taste
  • salt and pepper to taste (about 1/2 tsp of each)

Steps

  1. Season chicken liberally on both sides. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook undisturbed for 3-4 minutes.
  2. Flip just once, immediately add 1/3 cup chicken stock, reduce heat to simmer and cover pan, allow to cook 5 more minutes. Remove chicken and set aside on a plate tented with foil.
  3. Melt the butter over medium heat into the same skillet (some leftover chicken stock in the pan is fine). Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add salt and pepper.
  4. Add in 3/4 cup white wine and cook 2 minutes to allow it to reduce slightly. Then add 3/4 cup chicken stock and 3 tablespoons lemon juice. Slowly pour in the half and half then bring to a gentle boil. Add the pasta into the pan, breaking in half if needed or allow them to heat so you can bend them into the pan using tongs.
  5. Allow pasta to simmer for 4-5 minutes, stirring frequently, then reduce heat to low and continue to simmer until pasta is al dente.
  6. Add the parmesan gradually, reserving some for serving. The sauce will continue to thicken as the dish sits.
  7. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, lemon zest, red pepper flakes. Toss well and serve with sliced chicken and parmesan on top.

  • 1 green bell pepper, diced

  2. Reduce oven to 375°F and grease a 9×13 baking dish with oil. Allow the hash browns to thaw if still frozen.
  3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, bell peppers, salt, and pepper and sauté for 3–5 minutes, until softened.

  5. Whisk together the eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
  6. Spread the thawed hash browns evenly in the prepared baking dish. Top with the sausage & pepper mixture, then pour the egg mixture evenly over the top. Add shredded cheddar cheese and the chopped bacon.
  7. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking for another 20–25 minutes, until the eggs are set and the top is golden.
  8. Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy!
  9. TO MAKE AHEAD: After step 6, cover with foil and place in the refrigerator overnight (up to 24 hours). Remove from the fridge 20 minutes before baking to bring to room temperature, then bake covered for 30 minutes and uncovered for 30 minutes

Marry Me Chicken Orzo

This Marry Me Chicken Orzo is a treat of a one pot pasta recipe - super simple and takes just 30 minutes to make. All the flavours of our favourite Tuscan inspired chicken dish, made into a complete dinner.

Serves 4Prep 5 minCook 25 minTotal 30 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 650 g Chicken breast (Skinless and boneless. Chopped)
  • 1 tbsp Olive oil (Or oil from sun dried tomatoes jar)
  • 3 Garlic cloves (Peeled and crushed)
  • 170 g Sun-dried tomatoes (in oil) (Drained)
  • 1 tsp Oregano
  • 2 tsp Paprika
  • 250 g Orzo
  • 650 ml Hot chicken stock (Made with a stock cube (bouillon cube))
  • 150 ml Double cream (heavy cream (US/CAN) or (AUS) thickened cream)
  • 50 g Parmesan (Grated)
  • 120 g Spinach
  • Freshly ground black pepper

Steps

  1. Fry the chicken: In a large, deep frying pan, heat the oil over a medium heat. When it's hot, carefully add the chicken pieces. Cook for 5 minutes stirring occasionally until all sides are starting to colour.
  2. Garlic, tomatoes and herbs go in: Reduce the heat and add the garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano and paprika. Stir for 3-5 minutes until the garlic is softened.
  3. Pasta and stock in, then simmer: Add the orzo, stock, and some pepper and give everything a good stir and put the lid on. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the orzo is almost cooked.
  4. Reduce heat, time for spinach and cream: Turn the heat to the lowest setting add the spinach and cream and stir very well for 1-3 minutes until the spinach is wilted and the cream is heated through. Check the chicken is cooked through.
  5. To serve: Turn off the heat and stir in the parmesan.

Million Dollar Ravioli

This Million Dollar Ravioli is a rich and hearty baked ravioli casserole layered with seasoned ground beef meat sauce, tender cheese ravioli, and a homemade Parmesan cream sauce all topped with bubbly melted mozzarella.

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 40 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 25 ounces Cheese Ravioli
  • 1 pound Ground Beef
  • 24 ounces Pasta Sauce
  • 1/2 cup Yellow onion (diced)
  • 1 1/2 cups Heavy Whipping Cream
  • 1 1/2 cups Parmesan Cheese (shredded)
  • 1/4 cup Butter
  • 2 cups Mozzarella Cheese
  • 1 teaspoon Chicken Bouillon Powder
  • 1 teaspoon Onion Powder
  • 1 teaspoon Garlic Powder
  • 1 teaspoon Italian Seasoning
  • Salt and Black Pepper to taste

Steps

  1. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the ground beef and onions. Cook until the beef is browned and no longer pink, then drain the grease. Season with onion powder, garlic powder, and chicken bouillon powder. Stir in the pasta sauce and let it simmer for a few minutes before setting aside.
  2. In another skillet over low heat, melt the butter. Whisk in the heavy whipping cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Slowly add the Parmesan cheese in small handfuls, stirring well after each addition until the sauce is creamy and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then let the sauce cool slightly.
  3. Spread a layer of meat sauce into a 7x11 baking dish. Layer ravioli over the sauce, then add a layer of cream sauce. Repeat the layering process one more time and finish with meat sauce on top. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese evenly over the dish. Cover and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 10 minutes, then broil on high for 2–3 minutes until golden brown on top. Serve warm and enjoy!

Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 3 lbs beef chuck roast, cut into thirds
  • 1/3 cup low sodium tamari
  • 2 tbsp miso
  • 2 tbsp honey
  • 1 tbsp plus 1 tsp rice wine vinegar
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced or grated
  • 3 tbsp fresh ginger (3 inches), finely grated
  • 1 tsp red pepper flakes
  • Green onion, for garnish
  • Sesame seeds, for garnish

Steps

  1. Note: If using a Dutch oven or roasting pan with aluminum foil you will need to add 1 cup beef bone broth to your pot before roasting. If using a roasting pan with a cover you can omit.
  2. Preheat oven to 325°F.
  3. Combine tamari, miso, honey, vinegar, garlic, ginger and red pepper flakes in a small bowl and whisk well to combine.
  4. Pour over your beef and toss to coat evenly.
  5. Add meat to your roasting dish, cover and roast for 3 hours then remove from the oven and check for doneness. If meat pulls apart easily, shred into large chunks and toss in juices. If it does not pull apart easily, return it to the oven covered for 30 more minutes.
  6. Once meat has been shredded, increase oven temperature to 450°F and return to the oven uncovered to finish cooking for 15 minutes longer until the top layer of meat is crispy.
  7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

Old Fashioned Pot Roast Recipe Without Wine

This simple Old Fashioned Pot Roast Recipe Without Wine is made in the slow cooker and is melt-in-your-mouth tender. It is a classic comfort food that is perfect for Sunday dinner and will become a family favorite.

Serves 8Prep 25 minCook 300 minTotal 325 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 3.5-4 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, cut into 2 pieces
  • 1 Tablespoon Morton kosher salt*
  • 2 Tablespoons brown sugar
  • 1 teaspoon black pepper
  • 2-3 Tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 large onion, sliced
  • 10 cloves garlic, minced*
  • 1 Tablespoon Italian seasoning
  • 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
  • 2 Tablespoons Worcestershire
  • 1 Tablespoon soy sauce
  • 2 cups beef broth or beef stock
  • 1/4 cup cornstarch
  • 2 pounds baby yellow potatoes*
  • 1 pound whole carrots, peeled & cut on a bias into 2-3 inch pieces

Steps

  1. In a small bowl, combine the salt, brown sugar, and pepper. Rub and pat the spice mixture on all sides of each piece of the roast.
  2. In a large pot or skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat. Sear one piece of the roast at a time on all sides until dark brown. Place seared meat into the slow cooker. Reduce to medium heat.
  3. Add the onions to the remaining oil in the pot and sauté for 2-3 minutes, scraping any brown bits off the bottom of the pan. Add these to the slow cooker.
  4. Add the garlic, Italian seasoning, paprika, worcestershire, and soy sauce to the slow cooker. In a liquid measuring cup or small bowl, whisk together the broth and cornstarch. Pour the mixture over the roast, onions, and spices. The top of the roast will not be covered.
  5. Cover and cook on LOW for 6-7 hours or HIGH for 3.5-4 hours.
  6. Add the potatoes and carrots. Use the back of a spoon to press them into the broth so they are mostly covered in liquid.
  7. Cover and cook for an ADDITIONAL 3 hours on LOW or 1.5 hours on HIGH. (If you prefer softer veggies, see notes below.)
  8. Remove the roast and shred it into large pieces. Place on a serving platter with the pan juices. Use a slotted spoon to remove the veggies.

Source: Bites with Bri

Serves 6Prep 15 minCook 40 minTotal 55 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 6 chicken thighs or breasts ((skin on or off) )
  • 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil
  • 1/3 cup plain Greek yogurt
  • 1 tablespoon lemon zest
  • 2-4 cloves garlic, chopped
  • 1- teaspoons black pepper, using more to your taste
  • 2 teaspoons dried oregano
  • 1 teaspoon dried thyme
  • 1 teaspoon paprika
  • 1 teaspoon onion powder
  • kosher salt and chili flakes
  • 1 3/4 cups dry basmati rice
  • 2 tablespoons salted butter
  • 2 cups roughly chopped broccoli

Steps

  1. 1. In a bowl, toss together the chicken, olive oil, yogurt, lemon zest, garlic, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and a good pinch of salt and chili flakes (if desired). If time allows, marinate for 30 minutes or overnight.2. Preheat the oven to 400°. 3. Pour the rice and broccoli into a 9x13-inch baking dish. Pour over 2 cups of water. Add the butter. Arrange the chicken over the rice and broccoli. Add lemon wedges, if desired. Bake 30-40 minutes, until the rice is fluffy and the chicken is cooked through. If the rice is hard, add 1/3 cup water and cook for an additional 10 minutes. 4. Serve the chicken, rice, and broccoli topped with fresh basil and or thyme. And enjoy!

One Pot Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Orzo

If you love broccoli cheddar soup, this one pot chicken broccoli cheddar orzo is the perfect way to soft launch soup season for all of you who are craving fall!🍂🍁 One Pot Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Orzo

Serves 4

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 1 carrot, grated
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1 tbsp minced garlic
  • 1 cup orzo
  • 2 1/2 cups chicken stock
  • 1 tbsp chicken bouillon
  • 2 cups broccoli, chopped
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 8 oz cheddar cheese, freshly grated
  • Seasonings:
  • Garlic powder
  • Onion powder
  • Paprika
  • Salt
  • Black pepper

Steps

  1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper to taste. Cook until the chicken is fully cooked, then remove it from the pot and set aside.
  2. Melt the butter in the same pot. Add the diced onion and grated carrot, and cook for about 5 minutes, or until softened.
  3. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant. Season to taste. Pour in the chicken stock, then stir in the orzo and chicken bouillon. Bring to a boil and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
  4. Add the chopped broccoli, cover, and cook for another 5 minutes.
  5. Return the cooked chicken to the pot. Stir in the heavy cream and shredded cheddar cheese until smooth and creamy.
  6. Cover and cook over low heat for about 5 more minutes, or until the orzo is tender. Stir, serve, and enjoy!

Ingredients

  • 1 small onion, diced
  • 1 tsp each Italian seasoning, dried parsley, garlic powder, and dried basil
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper
  • 2 tbsp tomato paste
  • 2 1/2 cups chicken broth
  • 1 (24 oz) jar marinara sauce
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 lb fusilli pasta
  • 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, for topping
  • For the Lasagna Topping:
  • 1 cup ricotta cheese
  • 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
  • Parsley, salt, and pepper, to taste

Steps

  1. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the ground beef and diced onion until the beef is browned and the onion is softened. Drain any excess grease if needed.
  2. Stir in the Italian seasoning, parsley, garlic powder, basil, salt, pepper, and tomato paste. Cook for 1-2 minutes,
  3. Pour in the chicken broth, marinara sauce, and heavy cream. Stir well to combine.
  4. Add the uncooked fusilli pasta and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook according to the pasta package directions, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. Add additional broth if needed.
  5. While the pasta cooks, combine the ricotta cheese, ½ cup mozzarella cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
  6. Once the pasta is cooked, top the skillet with the remaining 1 cup of mozzarella cheese. Add dollops of the ricotta mixture over the top.
  7. Cover the skillet for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Garnish with additional parsley if desired and serve warm.

One-pan Korean-style Beef Noodles

These One-pan Korean-style Beef Noodles combine minced (ground) beef, ramen noodles and a creamy gochujang sauce in an easy family dinner that's ready in just 20 minutes. Everything cooks in the one pan for minimal washing up, making it perfect for busy weeknights when you want something a little different from the usual mince rotation.

Serves 4Prep 15 minCook 10 minTotal 25 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 3 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1½ tbsp dark soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp brown sugar or honey
  • 2 tbsp rice wine vinegar
  • 2 tbsp sesame oil
  • 2 tbsp gochujang (see note 1 for spice levels and subs)
  • 1 tbsp peanut butter (can be omitted)
  • 2 tbsp neutral oil
  • 500 g minced (ground) beef
  • 1 tsp freshly minced garlic
  • 1 tsp freshly minced ginger
  • 1 tbsp tomato paste
  • 250 ml coconut milk (see note 2 for substitutions)
  • 3 x 85 g (3 oz) bundles of ramen noodles, or any other instant noodle packets, flavouring sachets discarded (see note 3 for more details)
  • 375 ml water
  • 2 spring onions (scallions), finely sliced, plus extra to serve
  • Sesame seeds
  • Sliced cucumbers
  • Chilli oil (optional)

Steps

  1. Make the sauce – Combine the sauce ingredients in a small bowl or jug. Whisk to combine, then set aside.
  2. Cook the beef mince – Heat the oil in a large heavy-based pan with a lid over medium–high heat. Add the beef mince, break it up with a spatula and leave it undisturbed for 4–5 minutes until it begins to caramelise. Flip it over and continue cooking for a further 3–4 minutes until cooked through.
  3. Add the garlic and ginger – Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring, for 60 seconds.
  4. Stir in the tomato paste – Stir through the tomato paste.
  5. Add the sauce – Add the sauce, stir and cook for 60 seconds until slightly thickened.
  6. Add the coconut milk and noodles – Stir through the coconut milk, then add the noodles to the pan, followed immediately by the water. The noodles won't be completely submerged in the liquid and that is okay. Try and nestle them in so they are as submerged as possible with their tops exposed.
  7. Place the lid on – Cover and cook for 2 minutes. Uncover, turn the noodle bundles over using tongs and cover again. Cook for 1 minute.
  8. Uncover and add the spring onion – Uncover the pan, give the noodles another toss with tongs to absorb the sauce (they will continue to absorb the sauce as they sit). Add the spring onion and toss with tongs for 60 seconds or until the spring onion is well distributed. (See note 4 for sauce thickness.)
  9. Serve – Serve the noodles divided among four bowls, topped with extra spring onion, sesame seeds, sliced cucumbers and chilli oil, if using.

Source: Simple Home Edit

One-Pan Sesame Chicken and Rice

Serves 4Prep 5 minCook 60 minTotal 65 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, (trimmed of excess fat)
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
  • 3 tablespoons avocado oil
  • 3/4 cup finely diced yellow onion ((from about 1 small onion))
  • 3 garlic cloves, (minced)
  • 1 teaspoon freshly grated ginger
  • 1 cup white jasmine rice, (rinsed well and drained)
  • 1½ cups chicken broth
  • 6 green onions, (thinly sliced on the diagonal, white and green parts separated)
  • 1/4 cup tamari or low-sodium soy sauce
  • 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil
  • 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
  • 2 tablespoons honey
  • 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds, (for garnish)

Steps

  1. Preheat the oven to 350℉.
  2. Pat the chicken dry and season all over with salt and pepper.
  3. In a large oven-safe skillet with a tight-fitting lid, heat the oil over medium-high heat. When hot, add the chicken in a single layer, working in batches as needed to avoid overcrowding, and cook until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside. The chicken does not need to be fully cooked through as it will continue to cook in the oven.
  4. Reduce the heat to medium and add the onions. Cook, stirring, until the onions are softened, about 3 minutes.
  5. Add the garlic, ginger, and rice, and continue to cook, stirring, toasting the rice until fragrant and lightly browned, about 2 minutes.
  6. Stir in the broth and the white parts of the green onions and bring to a simmer, 3 to 5 minutes.
  7. In a small bowl, whisk together the tamari, toasted sesame oil, rice vinegar, and honey. Nestle the chicken back into the skillet, then drizzle the tamari mixture over the tops of the chicken. Cover, carefully transfer to the oven, and bake for 25 minutes. Carefully uncover the skillet and continue baking until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through, 10 to 12 minutes.
  8. Remove from the oven and fluff the rice with a fork. Garnish with the green parts of the onion and sesame seeds.

Source: The Defined Dish

Family ratings

Dad

Ingredients

  • 1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs, (cut into bite-sized pieces)
  • 1/2 cup cornstarch
  • 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1 egg, (beaten)
  • 1/2 cup orange juice, (fresh or bottled)
  • 1 tsp orange zest
  • 1/4 cup soy sauce
  • 1/3 cup brown sugar
  • 2 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 2 tbsp hoisin sauce
  • 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
  • 3 cloves garlic, (finely minced)
  • 1/2 tbsp ginger paste
  • 1-2 tbsp sriracha (optional, for heat)
  • 1/2 tbsp cornstarch, (mixed with 3 tbsp water)
  • Toasted sesame seeds
  • Sliced green onions
  • Red pepper flakes

Steps

  1. Heat a large pan over medium heat and add a few tablespoons of oil.
  2. Add the cubed chicken, cornstarch, flour, seasoning, and the beaten egg in a large ziplock bag or Tupperware. Seal it tightly with a lid and shake really well until the chicken is well coated.
  3. Once the oil is hot, add the chicken in a single layer (you may need to work in batches). Cook for 4-5 minutes per side, turning occasionally, until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown and crispy.
  4. Meanwhile, make the orange sauce. Add all the sauce ingredients to a bowl and whisk really well until fully combined.
  5. Once the chicken is cooked, lower the heat to medium-low and pour the sauce directly into the pan with the chicken. Toss everything together and let it simmer for 2-4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
  6. Remove from the heat and serve immediately with rice and your choice of veggie. Top with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onion. Enjoy!

Overnight Ham &amp; Cheese Croissant Casserole

Overnight Ham & Cheese Croissant Casserole 🥐🧀 Recipe below and on sammymotgoms.com ⬇️ Ingredients * 8 medium sized croissants cut in half, slightly dry * 6 eggs * 1 cup heavy cream * 10 large pieces ham roughly chopped (around 200 grams) * 2 cups sharp white cheddar shredded (around 250 grams) * 1 t

Serves 8Prep 10 minCook 30 minTotal 40 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 8 medium sized croissants (cut in half, slightly dry)
  • 6 eggs
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 10 large pieces ham (roughly chopped (around 200 grams))
  • 2 cups sharp white cheddar (shredded (around 250 grams))
  • 1 tbsp dijon mustard
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp dried thyme
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper
  • pinch of salt
  • confectioners' sugar (aka powdered sugar, optional for dusting)
  • honey drizzle (optional)

Steps

  1. Begin by lightly spraying your baking dish with a neutral cooking oil.
  2. Tear the croissants into large pieces (usually I just rip them in half), but you can do smaller if you'd like.Distribute the pieces evenly across the bottom of the prepared baking dish, lightly pressing them to fit snugly. It is fine if the pieces are not in a single layer.
  3. Slice the ham into bite-sized pieces, or simply fold multiple times. Distribute the ham and cheese across the croissants, aiming to tuck the pieces into the nooks and crevices between the croissant pieces. Gently lift a few croissant pieces to sneak fillings underneath. This step does not need to look perfect—it just ensures every bite has filling.
  4. Next in a medium sized bowl whisk together the eggs, cream, dijon mustard, onion powder, dried thyme, black pepper and pinch of salt.
  5. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the top of the croissants. Ensure the liquid covers all the tops of the croissants, but it does not need to be fully submerged.If you notice a few dry spots, take a cooking brush and lightly brush the tops of the drier croissants with any excess egg mixture from the dish.
  6. Cover with aluminum foil and chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour or overnight.
  7. Preheat the oven to 350 °F.Bake the ham and cheese croissant casserole (covered) for 20 to 25 minutes.Carefully remove the aluminum foil and continue baking for another 10 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese begins to bubble and it has achieved a beautiful golden-brown top layer.
  8. Lest rest for 5 minutes before serving.
  9. Dust with powdered sugar and a drizzle of honey.

PB&J Protein Muffins

These soft, protein-rich muffins bring the nostalgic flavor of peanut butter and jelly into a toddler-friendly snack. Made with simple ingredients like banana, Greek yogurt, oat flour, and a swirl of strawberry jam, they’re naturally sweet and filling. Perfect for busy mornings or packed lunches, they store well and freeze beautifully.

Serves 4Prep 10 minCook 12 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1 banana (ripe)
  • 1 egg
  • 1/4 cup peanut butter
  • 1/4 cup greek yogurt
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/2 cup oat flour ((just blend rolled oats))
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • 4 tsp strawberry jam

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350 F (175 C).
  2. Line or grease a mini muffin tin.
  3. In a bowl, mash the banana.
  4. Whisk in egg, peanut butter, greek yogurt, and vanilla until smooth.
  5. Add in oat flour and baking powder, and stir until just combined.
  6. Scoop batter into muffin cups, each about 3/4 full.
  7. Drop about 1/3 tsp strawberry jam on top of each muffin, and swirl gently with a toothpick.
  8. Bake for 14-16 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
  9. Let cool completely before serving to toddlers!

Peanut Butter Oreo Cheesecake Trifle

Peanut Butter Oreo Cheesecake Trifle

Serves 12

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • For the Pudding:
  • 1 3.9 oz box instant chocolate pudding
  • 2 cups (480 ml) cold whole milk
  • For the Peanut Butter Cheesecake Mousse:
  • 8 oz (226 g) full-fat cream cheese, softened
  • 3/4 cup (190 g) creamy peanut butter
  • 1/2 cup powdered sugar
  • 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
  • 1/4 teaspoon fine sea salt
  • 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) cold heavy whipping cream
  • For the Homemade Whipped Cream:
  • 1 cup (240 ml) cold heavy whipping cream
  • 2 tablespoons powdered sugar
  • 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
  • Pinch of fine sea salt
  • For layering:
  • 1 family size package Oreos, 3 1/2 cups coarsely crushed and the rest cut in half @OREO

Steps

  1. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the instant chocolate pudding and cold milk until smooth and refrigerate for 5 minutes to thicken. If it’s overly lumpy, you can hit it with an immersion blender until smooth.
  2. In a large bowl, beat cream cheese, powdered sugar, peanut butter, salt, and vanilla until smooth. Beat heavy cream until medium peaks form. Gently fold into cream cheese mixture until smooth. It will look separated at first, just keep folding until it comes together.
  3. Spoon ½ cup of chocolate pudding into the bottom of a 3 quart trifle bowl.
  4. Arrange halved Oreos around the inside edge of the bowl, then sprinkle 1 cup of crushed Oreos over the pudding.
  5. Spread ⅓ of the peanut butter cheesecake mousse over the Oreos.
  6. Top with half of the pudding.
  7. Repeat with another of layer of halved Oreos, crushed Oreos, ⅓ of the peanut butter cheesecake mousse, and the remaining pudding.:
  8. Finish with crushed Oreos and the final third of the peanut butter cheesecake mousse.:
  9. Cover the trifle bowl refrigerate for at least 8 hours, preferably overnight.
  10. Just before serving, make the whipped cream by beating all ingredients until medium peaks form.
  11. Spread over the top and sprinkle remaining crushed Oreos on top.

  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1/2 cup milk
  • 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 pound powdered sugar

Steps

  1. Preheat oven to 350Â°F. Grease a 15x10-inch sheet pan with butter or nonstick spray.
  2. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine peanut butter, water, butter, and oil. Bring to a boil, then turn off the heat.
  3. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together self rising flour and sugar. Add the hot peanut butter mixture, and mix until smooth.
  4. In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, buttermilk and vanilla extract. Add this mixture to the peanut butter mixture, and stir just until combined.
  5. Pour the batter into the prepared sheet pan, spreading evenly. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. Allow the cake to cool at least 20 minutes before adding the frosting.
  6. For the frosting, in a medium saucepan, combine milk, peanut butter, and vanilla. Once melted and fully combined, turn off the heat and stir in powdered sugar until smooth. Spread on the slightly cooled cake. Slice and serve.

Serves 12Prep 15 minCook 10 minTotal 55 min

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 1/3 cup pumpkin, drained and squeezed (see recipe)
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
  • 1 cup packed light brown sugar
  • 1 large egg yolk
  • 2 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
  • 1/4 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1/4 teaspoon salt
  • 2 teaspoons cinnamon
  • 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
  • 2/3 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips

Steps

  1. First, dry out the pumpkin. Place the pumpkin puree onto a thick paper towel (or cheesecloth). Carefully wrap the paper towel around the pumpkin and squeeze it over a small bowl to remove excess moisture. You should have about 1/4 cup of dried pumpkin left!
  2. In a large bowl, combine the melted butter, brown sugar, and dried pumpkin puree. Mix to combine.
  3. Add the egg yolk and vanilla extract. Mix well.
  4. Add the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Stir until just combined and no streaks of flour remain. Add the chocolate chips and use a rubber spatula to fold them into the batter.
  5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 30 minutes to chill.
  6. While the cookie dough chills, preheat the oven to 350°F and line a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Set aside.
  7. Once the dough has chilled, use a 1 ½ ounce cookie scoop to portion out equal amounts of dough. Place the dough balls 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheet and bake for 9 to 10 minutes or until the edges are set and the cookies have puffed up, but the middles are still somewhat soft in the midle.
  8. Allow to cool before eating!

  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1 teaspoon dried oregano
  • 1 teaspoon chili powder
  • 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 15 oz can artichoke hearts, quartered

Steps

  1. Instructions:
  2. Combine the olive oil, salt, garlic powder, oregano, and chili powder in a small bowl and set aside.
  3. Add the salmon filets to a large, flat container. Cover the filets with the oil and spice mixture. Use clean hands to gently rub the spices into the salmon. Top each filet with the chopped dill and parsley. Flip each filet facedown, then secure the cover on the container and chill for at least 20 minutes and up to 12 hours.
  4. While the salmon marinates, prepare the sauce: in a jar with a lid, mix together the yogurt, lemon juice, dill, parsley, and salt until well combined. Cover and chill until serving.
  5. Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 400F and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.
  6. Toss the potatoes in the olive oil, salt, oregano, chili powder, and garlic powder in a large bowl. Transfer to the sheet pan and bake until tender to a fork and beginning to crisp on the outside, 20 to 15 minutes.
  7. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and push the potatoes to one side of the pan. Add the marinated salmon to the pan skin side down.
  8. Add the artichoke hearts to the marinade container and mix to coat in the remaining marinade. Add the artichokes to the sheet pan (if your sheet pan is too small, artichokes can be cooked on a separate pan) and bake until salmon is cooked to an internal temperature of 145F, 10-16 minutes, depending on your preference. Remove from the oven and squeeze the lemon juice overtop the salmon.
  9. To serve, add a large spoonful of yogurt sauce to each plate, with the potatoes, artichokes, and salmon on top. Garnish with additional dill and parsley if desired.

Saucy Chicken Noodles

@kalejunkie 30-MIN SAUCY CHICKEN NOODLES (inspired by PAD THAI)✨ one of the best dinners I’ve made in so long.

Serves 4

Family ratings

Mom
Dad
Kids

Ingredients

  • 14 Ounces Rice Noodles (stir fry or pad thai noodles)
  • 1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
  • 1 Pound Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs (cut into bite size pieces)
  • 2 Tablespoon Low Sodium Soy Sauce
  • 1 Cup Bean Sprouts
  • 1 Red Bell Pepper (seed removed and sliced thin)
  • 1 Cup Carrot Matchsticks
  • 3 Cloves Garlic (mashed)
  • 2 Eggs
  • 1 Cup Green Onions (sliced thin (this is approximately 1 bunch))
  • ½ Cup Cilantro
  • 1 Lime (juiced)
  • 1/2 Teaspoon Crushed Red Pepper Flakes
  • 1/2 Cup Low Sodium Soy Sauce
  • 2 Tablespoon Toasted Sesame Oil
  • 3 Tablespoon Fish Sauce
  • 1/3 Cup Coconut Sugar
  • 3 Tablespoon Rice Vinegar
  • 1/4 Cup Creamy Peanut Butter
  • 1 Teaspoon Ground Ginger
  • 1/3 Cup Chopped Peanuts
  • 1 Lime (juiced and drizzled on top)

Steps

  1. To make this dish, start by preparing the noodles. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Once they're done, drain the water from them and set them aside.
  2. Next, heat a large pan, on the stove, over medium heat, and add in the olive oil.
  3. While the pan is heating, prepare the chicken by cutting the chicken thighs into bite sized pieces.
  4. Once the oil is hot, add the chicken to the pan alongside the soy sauce. Allow it to cook for 7-8 minutes, until it's browned on all sides and almost cooked through.
  5. Once the chicken is done, transfer it to a plate, being sure to leave the oil and chicken juices in the pan.
  6. Next, add the bean sprouts, bell pepper, carrots and garlic to the pan.
  7. Cook until the veggies in the oil and juices for approximately 4 minutes, until they start to soften.
  8. While the veggies are cooking, prepare the sauce by adding the toasted sesame oil, fish sauce, coconut sugar, rice vinegar, creamy peanut butter, and ground ginger to blender.
  9. Blend the sauce until it's smooth and creamy, then set it aside.
  10. Once the veggies are done, push them to one side of the pan.
  11. Then, crack both eggs into the other side of the pan and scramble them gently. Once the eggs are scrambled, combine them with the veggies.
  12. Add the chicken back to the pan, alongside the cooked noodles, sliced green onions, cilantro, lime juice, crushed red pepper flakes, and the sauce.
  13. Toss to combine, until the noodles and chicken are fully combined and coated in the sauce.
  14. Once the noodles are done, remove them from the heat. Garnish them with chopped cilantro, chopped peanuts, and a squeeze of lime juice, then serve and enjoy!

  • 1 tbsp oyster sauce

  • 3 cloves garlic, (finely minced)
  • 1/2 tbsp fresh ginger, (finely minced)

  • Choice of cooked veggie

Steps

  1. In a bowl, toss the chicken with cornstarch, salt, and pepper until lightly coated.
  2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.
  3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken in an even layer and let it cook undisturbed for 3 to 4 minutes to get some golden color. Flip and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes until cooked through. Remove the chicken to a plate.
  4. In the same pan, add a tiny bit more oil if needed. Add the white parts of the scallions, garlic, and ginger. Sauté for about 30 to 60 seconds until super fragrant.
  5. Pour in the sauce and let it simmer for 1 to 2 minutes to slightly thicken.
  6. Add the chicken back to the pan and toss to coat everything in the sauce.
  7. Turn off the heat and stir in the green parts of the scallions.
  8. Serve immediately with your choice of veggie and rice, enjoy!
